1.1.s: oṃ bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devāḥ | bhadraṃ paśyemākṣabhiryajatrāḥ | sthirairaṅgaistuṣṭuvāṃsastanūbhiḥ | vyaśema devahitaṃ yadāyuḥ | svasti na indro vṛddhaśravāḥ | svasti naḥ pūṣā viśvavedāḥ | svastinastārkṣyo ariṣṭanemiḥ | svasti no bṛhaspatirdadhātu | āpamāpāmapaḥ sarvāḥ | asmādasmādito'mutaḥ
1.1.d: ओं भद्रं कर्णेभिः शृणुयाम देवाः । भद्रं पश्येमाक्षभिर्यजत्राः । स्थिरैरङ्गैस्तुष्टुवांसस्तनूभिः । व्यशेम देवहितं यदायुः । स्वस्ति न इन्द्रो वृद्धश्रवाः । स्वस्ति नः पूषा विश्ववेदाः । स्वस्तिनस्तार्क्ष्यो अरिष्टनेमिः । स्वस्ति नो बृहस्पतिर्दधातु । आपमापामपः सर्वाः । अस्मादस्मादितोऽमुतः
1.1.m:
May we hear what is auspicious with our ears, O gods; / may we see what is auspicious with our eyes, O holy ones! / Praising with firm limbs and bodies, / may we attain the lifespan ordained by the gods. / May Indra of ancient renown grant us well-being; / may Pūṣan, knower of all, grant us well-being; / may Tārkṣya, whose wheel-rim is unbroken, grant us well-being; / may Bṛhaspati ordain well-being for us. / Oṃ. Peace, peace, peace.

Oṃ. May we hear what is auspicious with our ears, O gods; / may we see what is auspicious with our eyes, O holy ones! / Praising with firm limbs and bodies, / may we attain the lifespan ordained by the gods. / May Indra of ancient renown grant us well-being; / may Pūṣan, knower of all, grant us well-being; / may Tārkṣya, whose wheel-rim is unbroken, grant us well-being; / may Bṛhaspati ordain well-being for us. / All the waters, water after water, / from this [world], from this, from here, from yonder,

1.1.s: agnirvāyuśca sūryaśca | saha saṃcaskararddhiyā | vāyvaśvā raśmipatayaḥ | marīcyātmāno adruhaḥ | devīrbhuvanasūvarīḥ | putravatvāya me suta | mahānāmnīrmahāmānāḥ | mahaso mahasassvaḥ | devīḥ parjanyasūvarīḥ | putravatvāya me suta
1.1.d: अग्निर्वायुश्च सूर्यश्च । सह संचस्करर्द्धिया । वाय्वश्वा रश्मिपतयः । मरीच्यात्मानो अद्रुहः । देवीर्भुवनसूवरीः । पुत्रवत्वाय मे सुत । महानाम्नीर्महामानाः । महसो महसस्स्वः । देवीः पर्जन्यसूवरीः । पुत्रवत्वाय मे सुत
1.1.m: Agni and Vāyu and Sūrya / prepared together with prosperity. / Wind-steeded, lords of rays, / having the nature of beams, free from malice, / divine bringers of worlds, / press [soma] for me, that I may possess sons! / Great-named, possessing great honour, / light of great splendour, / divine bringers of Parjanya, / press [soma] for me, that I may possess sons!

1.1.s: apāśnyuṣṇimapā rakṣaḥ | apāśnyuṣṇimapāragham | apāghrāmapa cāvartim | apadevīrito hita | vajraṃ devīrajītāṃśca | bhuvanaṃ devasūvarīḥ | ādityānaditiṃ devīm | yoninordhvamudīṣata | śivā naḥ śantamā bhavantu | divyā āpa oṣadhayaḥ | sumṛḍīkā sarasvati | mā te vyoma saṃdṛśi
1.1.d: अपाश्न्युष्णिमपा रक्षः । अपाश्न्युष्णिमपारघम् । अपाघ्रामप चावर्तिम् । अपदेवीरितो हित । वज्रं देवीरजीतांश्च । भुवनं देवसूवरीः । आदित्यानदितिं देवीम् । योनिनोर्ध्वमुदीषत । शिवा नः शन्तमा भवन्तु । दिव्या आप ओषधयः । सुमृडीका सरस्वति । मा ते व्योम संदृशि
1.1.m: Drive away hunger and burning heat, drive away the rakṣas; / drive away hunger and burning heat, drive away evil; / drive away foul odour and drive away distress; / drive away, O goddesses, from here what is placed [against us]. / The thunderbolt, the goddesses, and the unconquered ones, / bringers of the divine world, / the Ādityas, the goddess Aditi, / rose upward with the womb. / Auspicious and most peaceful to us may they be: / the heavenly waters and the plants. / Full of grace, O Sarasvatī; / may we not see your empty sky! / Yonder pressed, plants, and two.

1.2.s: smṛtiḥ pratyakṣamaitihyam | anumānaścatuṣṭayam | etairādityamaṇḍalam | sarvaireva vidhāsyate | sūryo marīcimādatte | sarvasmādbhuvanādadhi | tasyāḥ pākaviśeṣeṇa | smṛtaṃ kālaviśeṣaṇam | nadīva prabhavātkācit | akṣayyāthsyandate yathā
1.2.d: स्मृतिः प्रत्यक्षमैतिह्यम् । अनुमानश्चतुष्टयम् । एतैरादित्यमण्डलम् । सर्वैरेव विधास्यते । सूर्यो मरीचिमादत्ते । सर्वस्माद्भुवनादधि । तस्याः पाकविशेषेण । स्मृतं कालविशेषणम् । नदीव प्रभवात्काचित् । अक्षय्याथ्स्यन्दते यथा
1.2.m: Tradition, direct perception, historical transmission, / and inference—this tetrad: / by all these indeed / the solar orb is established. / Sūrya draws in the ray / from above the entire world; / by its specific ripening, / the differentiation of time is remembered, / as a river from its source, / inexhaustible, then flows.

1.2.s: tānnadyo'bhisamāyanti | sorussatī na nivartate | evannānāsamutthānāḥ | kālāssaṃvathsaraṃ śritāḥ | aṇuśaśca mahaśaśca | sarve samavayantritam | sataissarvaiḥ samāviṣṭaḥ | ūrussanna nivartate | adhisaṃvathsaraṃ vidyāt | tadeva lakṣaṇe
1.2.d: तान्नद्योऽभिसमायन्ति । सोरुस्सती न निवर्तते । एवन्नानासमुत्थानाः । कालास्संवथ्सरं श्रिताः । अणुशश्च महशश्च । सर्वे समवयन्त्रितम् । सतैस्सर्वैः समाविष्टः । ऊरुस्सन्न निवर्तते । अधिसंवथ्सरं विद्यात् । तदेव लक्षणे
1.2.m: Rivers flow together toward it; / becoming broad, it does not turn back. / Thus times arising from various [sources] / depend on the year. / In minute parts and in great parts, / all are restrained together. / Pervaded by all of them, / being broad, it does not turn back. / One should know this as the overseer of the year; / that indeed is in the mark.

1.2.s: aṇubhiśca mahadbhiśca | samārūḍhaḥ pradṛśyate | saṃvathsaraḥ pratyakṣeṇa | nādhisattvaḥ pradṛśyate | paṭaro viklidhaḥ piṅgaḥ | etadvaruṇalakṣaṇam | yatraitadupadṛśyate | sahasraṃ tatra nīyate | ekaṃhi śiro nānā mukhe | kṛthsnaṃ tadṛtulakṣaṇam
1.2.d: अणुभिश्च महद्भिश्च । समारूढः प्रदृश्यते । संवथ्सरः प्रत्यक्षेण । नाधिसत्त्वः प्रदृश्यते । पटरो विक्लिधः पिङ्गः । एतद्वरुणलक्षणम् । यत्रैतदुपदृश्यते । सहस्रं तत्र नीयते । एकंहि शिरो नाना मुखे । कृथ्स्नं तदृतुलक्षणम्
1.2.m: Mounted upon by small and by great, / it is seen. / The year is visible by direct perception; / its overarching reality is not seen. / Variegated, dripping, reddish-brown— / this is the mark of Varuṇa. / Wherever this is observed, / a thousand is led there. / One head indeed, with manifold faces: / that is the entire mark of the seasons.

1.2.s: ubhayatassaptendriyāṇi | jalpitaṃ tveva dihyate | śuklakṛṣṇe saṃvathsarasya | dakṣiṇavāmayoḥ pārśvayoḥ | tasyaiṣā bhavati | śukraṃ te anyadyajataṃ te anyat | viṣurūpe ahanī dyaurivāsi | viśvā hi māyā avasi svadhāvaḥ | bhadrā te pūṣanniha rātirastviti | nātra bhuvanam | na pūṣā | na paśavaḥ | nādityassaṃvathsara eva pratyakṣeṇa priyatamaṃ vidyāt | etadvai saṃvathsarasya priyatamaṃ rūpam | yo'sya mahānartha utpathsyamāno bhavati | idaṃ puṇyaṃ kuruṣveti | tamāharaṇaṃ dadyāt
1.2.d: उभयतस्सप्तेन्द्रियाणि । जल्पितं त्वेव दिह्यते । शुक्लकृष्णे संवथ्सरस्य । दक्षिणवामयोः पार्श्वयोः । तस्यैषा भवति । शुक्रं ते अन्यद्यजतं ते अन्यत् । विषुरूपे अहनी द्यौरिवासि । विश्वा हि माया अवसि स्वधावः । भद्रा ते पूषन्निह रातिरस्त्विति । नात्र भुवनम् । न पूषा । न पशवः । नादित्यस्संवथ्सर एव प्रत्यक्षेण प्रियतमं विद्यात् । एतद्वै संवथ्सरस्य प्रियतमं रूपम् । योऽस्य महानर्थ उत्पथ्स्यमानो भवति । इदं पुण्यं कुरुष्वेति । तमाहरणं दद्यात्
1.2.m: On both sides are seven sense-organs; / speech alone is smeared [upon them]. / The white and black [fortnights] of the year / are on its right and left flanks. / Concerning this there is this [verse]: / 'Bright is one [form] of yours, venerable is your other; / having diverse forms, you are like day and sky; / for you protect all magical powers, O self-dependent one; / auspicious may your gift be here, O Pūṣan!' / Here there is no world, / no Pūṣan, / no cattle, / no Āditya; one should know that by direct perception the year alone is the dearest. / This indeed is the dearest form of the year. / If a great misfortune is about to arise for him, / [saying,] 'Perform this meritorious deed,' / one should give him that offering. / As the mark, the mark of the season, the world, and seven.

1.3.s: sākaṃjānāṃ saptathamāhurekajam | ṣaḍudyamā ṛṣayo devajā iti | teṣāmiṣṭāni vihitāni dhāmaśaḥ | sthātre rejante vikṛtāni rūpaśaḥ | ko nu maryā amithitaḥ | sakhā sakhāyamabravīt | jahāko asmadīṣate | yastityāja sakhividaṃ sakhāyam | na tasya vācyapi bhāgo asti | yadīṃ śṛṇotyalakaṃ śṛṇoti
1.3.d: साकंजानां सप्तथमाहुरेकजम् । षडुद्यमा ऋषयो देवजा इति । तेषामिष्टानि विहितानि धामशः । स्थात्रे रेजन्ते विकृतानि रूपशः । को नु मर्या अमिथितः । सखा सखायमब्रवीत् । जहाको अस्मदीषते । यस्तित्याज सखिविदं सखायम् । न तस्य वाच्यपि भागो अस्ति । यदीं शृणोत्यलकं शृणोति
1.3.m: 'Of those born together, they call the seventh single-born; / six are twin-seers, born of gods,' [they say]. / Their desired [courses] are arranged according to their stations; / they tremble for the fixed one, modified according to forms. / Who then, O mortals, without being reviled, / friend spoke unto friend: / 'He who abandons, departs from us.' / He who has abandoned a friend who knows friendship, / has no share even in speech. / What he hears, he hears in vain,

1.3.s: na hi praveda sukṛtasya panthāmiti | ṛturṛtunā nudyamānaḥ | vinanādābhidhāvaḥ | ṣaṣṭiśca triṃśakā valgāḥ | śuklakṛṣṇau ca ṣāṣṭikau | sārāgavastrairjaradakṣaḥ | vasanto vasubhissaha | saṃvathsarasya savituḥ | praiṣakṛtprathamaḥ smṛtaḥ | amūnādayatetyanyān
1.3.d: न हि प्रवेद सुकृतस्य पन्थामिति । ऋतुरृतुना नुद्यमानः । विननादाभिधावः । षष्टिश्च त्रिंशका वल्गाः । शुक्लकृष्णौ च षाष्टिकौ । सारागवस्त्रैर्जरदक्षः । वसन्तो वसुभिस्सह । संवथ्सरस्य सवितुः । प्रैषकृत्प्रथमः स्मृतः । अमूनादयतेत्यन्यान्
1.3.m: for he does not know the path of good action. / Urged by season after season, / running toward, it resounded. / Sixty reins and thirty, / and two sixty-day [periods], white and black. / Aged-eyed with deep-dyed garments, / spring along with the Vasus, / the first dispatcher of Savitṛ, the year, / is remembered. / 'Make these eat,' [they say to] the others,

1.3.s: amūṃśca parirakṣataḥ | etā vācaḥ prayujyante | yatraitadupadṛśyate | etadeva vijānīyāt | pramāṇaṃ kālaparyaye | viśeṣaṇaṃ tu vakṣyāmaḥ | ṛtūnāṃ tannibodhata | śuklavāsā rudragaṇaḥ | grīṣmeṇā''vartate saha | nijahanpṛthivīṃ sarvām
1.3.d: अमूंश्च परिरक्षतः । एता वाचः प्रयुज्यन्ते । यत्रैतदुपदृश्यते । एतदेव विजानीयात् । प्रमाणं कालपर्यये । विशेषणं तु वक्ष्यामः । ऋतूनां तन्निबोधत । शुक्लवासा रुद्रगणः । ग्रीष्मेणा'ऽवर्तते सह । निजहन्पृथिवीं सर्वाम्
1.3.m: 'and protect these!' / These utterances are employed / wherever this is observed. / This alone one should recognize / as the measure in the succession of time. / But we shall state the distinction / of the seasons; comprehend it! / Clad in white garments, the troop of Rudras / revolves along with summer, / striking down the entire earth

1.3.s: jyotiṣā'pratikhyena saḥ | viśvarūpāṇi vāsāṃsi | ādityānāṃ nibodhata | saṃvathsarīṇaṃ karmaphalam | varṣābhirdadatāṃ saha | aduḥkho duḥkhacakṣuriva | tadmā pīta iva dṛśyate | śītenāvyathayanniva | rurudakṣa iva dṛśyate | hlādayate jvalataścaiva | śāmyataścāsya cakṣuṣī | yā vai prajā bhraṃśyante | saṃvathsarāttā bhraṃśyante | yāḥ pratitiṣṭhanti | saṃvathsare tāḥ pratitiṣṭhanti | varṣābhya ityarthaḥ
1.3.d: ज्योतिषाऽप्रतिख्येन सः । विश्वरूपाणि वासांसि । आदित्यानां निबोधत । संवथ्सरीणं कर्मफलम् । वर्षाभिर्ददतां सह । अदुःखो दुःखचक्षुरिव । तद्मा पीत इव दृश्यते । शीतेनाव्यथयन्निव । रुरुदक्ष इव दृश्यते । ह्लादयते ज्वलतश्चैव । शाम्यतश्चास्य चक्षुषी । या वै प्रजा भ्रंश्यन्ते । संवथ्सरात्ता भ्रंश्यन्ते । याः प्रतितिष्ठन्ति । संवथ्सरे ताः प्रतितिष्ठन्ति । वर्षाभ्य इत्यर्थः
1.3.m: with his irresistible light. / Garments of all forms / of the Ādityas, comprehend! / Giving together with the rains / the fruit of the year's action. / Free from pain, yet as if with pained eyes, / his body appears as if yellow; / as if not causing suffering through cold, / he appears as if weeping-eyed. / Both gladdening and blazing, / his two eyes also grow calm. / Whichsoever creatures fall away, / they fall away from the year; / whichsoever stand firm, / they stand firm in the year. / 'From the rains' is the meaning. / Hears, others, all indeed, and six.

1.4.s: akṣiduḥkhotthitasyaiva | viprasanne kanīnike | āṅkte cādgaṇaṃ nāsti | ṛbhūṇāṃ tannibodhata | kanakābhāni vāsāṃsi | ahatāni nibodhata | annamaśnīta mṛjmīta | ahaṃ vo jīvanapradaḥ | etā vācaḥ prayujyante | śaradyatropadṛśyate
1.4.d: अक्षिदुःखोत्थितस्यैव । विप्रसन्ने कनीनिके । आङ्क्ते चाद्गणं नास्ति । ऋभूणां तन्निबोधत । कनकाभानि वासांसि । अहतानि निबोधत । अन्नमश्नीत मृज्मीत । अहं वो जीवनप्रदः । एता वाचः प्रयुज्यन्ते । शरद्यत्रोपदृश्यते
1.4.m: Like one who has just risen from eye-pain, / his two pupils clear, / and when anointing there is no obstruction— / comprehend that of the Ṛbhus! / Garments shining like gold, / unworn, comprehend! / 'Eat food, wipe clean, / I am the giver of life to you!' / These utterances are employed / wherever it is observed in autumn.

1.4.s: abhidhūnvanto'bhighnanta iva | vātavanto marudgaṇāḥ | amuto jetumiṣumukhamiva | sannaddhāssaha dadṛśe ha | apadhvastairvastivarṇairiva | viśikhāsaḥ kapardinaḥ | akruddhasya yothsyamānasya | kruddhasyeva lohinī | hemataścakṣuṣī vidyāt | akṣṇayoḥ kṣipaṇoriva
1.4.d: अभिधून्वन्तोऽभिघ्नन्त इव । वातवन्तो मरुद्गणाः । अमुतो जेतुमिषुमुखमिव । सन्नद्धास्सह ददृशे ह । अपध्वस्तैर्वस्तिवर्णैरिव । विशिखासः कपर्दिनः । अक्रुद्धस्य योथ्स्यमानस्य । क्रुद्धस्येव लोहिनी । हेमतश्चक्षुषी विद्यात् । अक्ष्णयोः क्षिपणोरिव
1.4.m: As if blowing away, as if striking down, / the windy troops of the Maruts / assembled together were seen / as if an arrow-point to conquer from yonder; / as if with ruined bladder-colours, / shaven-headed, wearing braided hair. / Of one not angry but about to fight, / like one angry, [his eyes are] red; / one should know the two eyes of winter / in the eye-sockets, as if [arrows] from two bows.

1.4.s: durbhikṣaṃ devalokeṣu | manūnāmudakaṃ gṛhe | etā vācaḥ pravadantīḥ | vaidyuto yānti śaiśirīḥ | tā agniḥ pavamānā anvaikṣata | iha jīvikāmaparipaśyan | tasyaiṣā bhavati | iheha vassvatapasaḥ | marutassūryatvacaḥ | śarma saprathā āvṛṇe
1.4.d: दुर्भिक्षं देवलोकेषु । मनूनामुदकं गृहे । एता वाचः प्रवदन्तीः । वैद्युतो यान्ति शैशिरीः । ता अग्निः पवमाना अन्वैक्षत । इह जीविकामपरिपश्यन् । तस्यैषा भवति । इहेह वस्स्वतपसः । मरुतस्सूर्यत्वचः । शर्म सप्रथा आवृणे
1.4.m: Famine in the worlds of the gods, / water in the house of mortals: / uttering these words, / the lightning flashes of cool season depart. / Agni Pavamāna looked after them, / not seeing a livelihood here. / Concerning this there is this [verse]: / 'Here and here, of your own ascetic heat, / Maruts with the skin of Sūrya, / I choose broad protection!' / Appears as if, I choose.

1.5.s: atitāmrāṇi vāsāṃsi | aṣṭivajriśataghni ca | viśve devā vipraharanti | agnijihvā asaścata | naiva devo na martyaḥ | na rājā varuṇo vibhuḥ | nāgnirnendro na pavamānaḥ | mātṛkkaccana vidyate | divyasyaikā dhanurārtniḥ | pṛthivyāmaparā śritā
1.5.d: अतिताम्राणि वासांसि । अष्टिवज्रिशतघ्नि च । विश्वे देवा विप्रहरन्ति । अग्निजिह्वा असश्चत । नैव देवो न मर्त्यः । न राजा वरुणो विभुः । नाग्निर्नेन्द्रो न पवमानः । मातृक्कच्चन विद्यते । दिव्यस्यैका धनुरार्त्निः । पृथिव्यामपरा श्रिता
1.5.m: Deep copper-red are their garments; they wield missiles, thunderbolts, and śataghnīs. / The All-gods cast [them] forth; fire-tongued, they clung together. / Neither a god nor a mortal, / nor King Varuṇa, the all-pervading, / nor Agni, nor Indra, nor Pavamāna— / no measure whatsoever is known. / One tip of the celestial bow rested on the sky; / the other rested on the earth.

1.5.s: tasyendro vamrirūpeṇa | dhanurjyāmachinathsvayam | tadindradhanurityajyam | abhravarṇeṣu cakṣate | etadeva śaṃyorbārhaspatyasya | etadrudrasya dhanuḥ | rudrasya tveva dhanurārtniḥ | śira utpipeṣa | sa pravargyo'bhavat | tasmādyassapravargyeṇa yajñena yajate | rudrasya sa śiraḥ pratidadhāti | nainaṃ rudra āruko bhavati | ya evaṃ veda
1.5.d: तस्येन्द्रो वम्रिरूपेण । धनुर्ज्यामछिनथ्स्वयम् । तदिन्द्रधनुरित्यज्यम् । अभ्रवर्णेषु चक्षते । एतदेव शंयोर्बार्हस्पत्यस्य । एतद्रुद्रस्य धनुः । रुद्रस्य त्वेव धनुरार्त्निः । शिर उत्पिपेष । स प्रवर्ग्योऽभवत् । तस्माद्यस्सप्रवर्ग्येण यज्ञेन यजते । रुद्रस्य स शिरः प्रतिदधाति । नैनं रुद्र आरुको भवति । य एवं वेद
1.5.m: Indra himself, in the form of an ant, / cut its bowstring. / That is known as 'Indra's bow' / when seen in the colors of the clouds. / This is verily [the bow] of Śaṃyu, son of Bṛhaspati; / this is the bow of Rudra. / The bow-tip indeed smashed Rudra's head. / That became the pravargya. / Therefore, whoever sacrifices with a sacrifice containing the pravargya restores Rudra's head. / Rudra does not become harmful to him who knows thus.

1.6.s: atyūrdhvākṣo'tiraścāt | śiśiraḥ pradṛśyate | naiva rūpaṃ na vāsāṃsi | na cakṣuḥ pratidṛśyate | anyonyaṃ tu na hiṃsrātaḥ | satastaddevalakṣaṇam | lohito'kṣṇi śāraśīrṣṇiḥ | sūryasyodayanaṃ prati | tvaṃ karoṣinyañjalikām | tvaṃ karoṣi nijānukām
1.6.d: अत्यूर्ध्वाक्षोऽतिरश्चात् । शिशिरः प्रदृश्यते । नैव रूपं न वासांसि । न चक्षुः प्रतिदृश्यते । अन्योन्यं तु न हिंस्रातः । सतस्तद्देवलक्षणम् । लोहितोऽक्ष्णि शारशीर्ष्णिः । सूर्यस्योदयनं प्रति । त्वं करोषिन्यञ्जलिकाम् । त्वं करोषि निजानुकाम्
1.6.m: Eyes turned high above, yet looking sideways, / Śiśira appears. / Neither form nor garments, / nor eyes are visibly perceived. / Yet they do not injure each other; / that is the characteristic of what is real, of a god. / Red in the eyes, variegated on the head, / facing the rising of the sun: / 'You bend your hands together, / you bend your knees.'

1.6.s: nijānukā menyañjalikā | amī vācamupāsatāmiti | tasmai sarva ṛtavo namante | maryādākaratvātprapurodhām | brāhmaṇa āpnoti | ya evaṃ veda | sa khalu saṃvathsara etaissenānībhissaha | indrāya sarvānkāmānabhivahati | sa drapsaḥ | tasyaiṣā bhavati
1.6.d: निजानुका मेन्यञ्जलिका । अमी वाचमुपासतामिति । तस्मै सर्व ऋतवो नमन्ते । मर्यादाकरत्वात्प्रपुरोधाम् । ब्राह्मण आप्नोति । य एवं वेद । स खलु संवथ्सर एतैस्सेनानीभिस्सह । इन्द्राय सर्वान्कामानभिवहति । स द्रप्सः । तस्यैषा भवति
1.6.m: 'Bending the knee, bending the hands together, / let those yonder attend upon the word.' / To him all the seasons bow down. / Because he maintains boundaries, / a brāhmaṇa attains the office of chief priest, whoever knows thus. / That year, indeed, together with these commanders of armies, / brings all desires to Indra. / He is the drop. Regarding that, there is this [verse]:

1.6.s: avadrapso aṃśumatīmatiṣṭhat | iyānaḥ kṛṣṇo daśabhiḥ sahasraiḥ | āvartamindraḥ śacyā dhamantam | upasnuhi taṃ nṛmaṇāmathadrāmiti | etayaivendraḥ salāvṛkyā saha | asurānparivṛścati | pṛthivyaṃśumatī | tāmanvavasthitaḥ saṃvathsaro divaṃ ca | naivaṃ viduṣā''cāryāntevāsinau | anyonyasmai druhyātām | yo druhyati | bhraśyate svargāllokāt | ityṛtumaṇḍalāni | sūryamaṇḍalānyākhyāyikāḥ | ata ūrdhvaṃ sanirvacanāḥ
1.6.d: अवद्रप्सो अंशुमतीमतिष्ठत् । इयानः कृष्णो दशभिः सहस्रैः । आवर्तमिन्द्रः शच्या धमन्तम् । उपस्नुहि तं नृमणामथद्रामिति । एतयैवेन्द्रः सलावृक्या सह । असुरान्परिवृश्चति । पृथिव्यंशुमती । तामन्ववस्थितः संवथ्सरो दिवं च । नैवं विदुषा'ऽचार्यान्तेवासिनौ । अन्योन्यस्मै द्रुह्याताम् । यो द्रुह्यति । भ्रश्यते स्वर्गाल्लोकात् । इत्यृतुमण्डलानि । सूर्यमण्डलान्याख्यायिकाः । अत ऊर्ध्वं सनिर्वचनाः
1.6.m: 'The drop descended, standing by the Aṃśumatī, / Kṛṣṇa rushing with ten thousand [followers]; / Indra, blowing away the swirling [foe] by his might— / approach him, O manly-minded one, then run.' / With this very [hymn], along with a hyena, / Indra cuts down the asuras. / The earth is Aṃśumatī; / the year and the sky are situated along it. / Let not a teacher and a student who know thus / be treacherous toward one another. / Whoever is treacherous / falls from the heavenly world. / Thus are the seasonal circles, / the solar circles, the narratives. / Henceforth, they are with their etymologies.

1.7.s: ārogo bhrājaḥ paṭaraḥ pataṅgaḥ | svarṇaro jyotiṣīmān vibhāsaḥ | te asmai sarve divamātapanti | ūrjaṃ duhānā anapasphuranta iti | kaśyapo'ṣṭamaḥ | sa mahāmeruṃ na jahāti | tasyaiṣā bhavati | yatte śilpaṃ kaśyapa rocanāvat | indriyāvatpuṣkalaṃ citrabhānu | yasminthsūryā arpitāssapta sākam
1.7.d: आरोगो भ्राजः पटरः पतङ्गः । स्वर्णरो ज्योतिषीमान् विभासः । ते अस्मै सर्वे दिवमातपन्ति । ऊर्जं दुहाना अनपस्फुरन्त इति । कश्यपोऽष्टमः । स महामेरुं न जहाति । तस्यैषा भवति । यत्ते शिल्पं कश्यप रोचनावत् । इन्द्रियावत्पुष्कलं चित्रभानु । यस्मिन्थ्सूर्या अर्पितास्सप्त साकम्
1.7.m: 'Āroga, Bhrāja, Paṭara, Pataṅga, / Svarṇara, Jyotiṣīmat, Vibhāsa— / these all heat the sky for him, / milking out strength, never stumbling.' / Kaśyapa is the eighth; / he does not abandon Mahāmeru. / Regarding that, there is this [verse]: / 'What craft is yours, O Kaśyapa, luminous, / endowed with strength, abundant, wondrously bright, / in which the seven suns are set together—'

1.7.s: tasminrājānamadhiviśrayemamiti | te asmai sarve kaśyapājjyotirlabhante | tānthsomaḥ kaśyapādadhi nirdhamati | bhrastākarmakṛdivaivam | prāṇo jīvānīndriyajīvāni | sapta śīrṣaṇyāḥ prāṇāḥ | sūryā ityācāryāḥ | apaśyamahametānthsapta sūryāniti | pañcakarṇo vāthsyāyanaḥ | saptakarṇaśca plākṣiḥ
1.7.d: तस्मिन्राजानमधिविश्रयेममिति । ते अस्मै सर्वे कश्यपाज्ज्योतिर्लभन्ते । तान्थ्सोमः कश्यपादधि निर्धमति । भ्रस्ताकर्मकृदिवैवम् । प्राणो जीवानीन्द्रियजीवानि । सप्त शीर्षण्याः प्राणाः । सूर्या इत्याचार्याः । अपश्यमहमेतान्थ्सप्त सूर्यानिति । पञ्चकर्णो वाथ्स्यायनः । सप्तकर्णश्च प्लाक्षिः
1.7.m: '—upon that let us place this king.' / All these [suns] obtain light from Kaśyapa. / Soma blows them out from Kaśyapa, / just like an artisan at a forge. / Vital breath is the living beings; the senses are living beings. / The seven vital breaths of the head / are the suns, so say the teachers. / 'I saw these seven suns,' said Pañcakarṇa Vātsāyana / and Saptakarṇa Plākṣi.

1.7.s: ānuśravika eva nau kaśyapa iti | ubhau vedayite | na hi śekumiva mahāmeruṃ gantum | apaśyamahametathsūryamaṇḍalaṃ parivartamānam | gārgyaḥ prāṇatrātaḥ | gacchanta mahāmerum | ekaṃ cājahatam | bhrājapaṭarapataṅgā nihane | tiṣṭhannātapanti | tasmādiha taptritapāḥ
1.7.d: आनुश्रविक एव नौ कश्यप इति । उभौ वेदयिते । न हि शेकुमिव महामेरुं गन्तुम् । अपश्यमहमेतथ्सूर्यमण्डलं परिवर्तमानम् । गार्ग्यः प्राणत्रातः । गच्छन्त महामेरुम् । एकं चाजहतम् । भ्राजपटरपतङ्गा निहने । तिष्ठन्नातपन्ति । तस्मादिह तप्त्रितपाः
1.7.m: 'Kaśyapa is known to us only by tradition,' / both declare, / for they could not reach Mahāmeru. / 'I saw this solar disc revolving,' / said Gārgya Prāṇatrāta, / 'going to Mahāmeru, / and leaving one [sun behind].' / Bhrāja, Paṭara, and Pataṅga, standing below, heat [here]; / therefore here there is triple heat;

1.7.s: amutretare | tasmādihātaptritapāḥ | teṣāmeṣā bhavati | sapta sūryā divamanupraviṣṭāḥ | tānanveti pathibhirdakṣiṇāvān | te asmai sarve ghṛtamātapanti | ūrjaṃ duhānā anapasphuranta iti | saptartvijassūryā ityācāryāḥ | teṣāmeṣā bhavati | sapta diśo nānāsūryāḥ
1.7.d: अमुत्रेतरे । तस्मादिहातप्त्रितपाः । तेषामेषा भवति । सप्त सूर्या दिवमनुप्रविष्टाः । तानन्वेति पथिभिर्दक्षिणावान् । ते अस्मै सर्वे घृतमातपन्ति । ऊर्जं दुहाना अनपस्फुरन्त इति । सप्तर्त्विजस्सूर्या इत्याचार्याः । तेषामेषा भवति । सप्त दिशो नानासूर्याः
1.7.m: the others [heat] up there; / therefore here there is not triple heat. / Regarding them, there is this [verse]: / 'Seven suns have entered into the sky; / the giver of sacrificial gifts follows them along the paths. / All of them heat clarified butter for him, / milking out strength, never stumbling.' / The seven priests are the suns, so say the teachers. / Regarding them, there is this [verse]: / 'Seven quarters, various suns;

1.7.s: sapta hotāra ṛtvijaḥ | devā ādityā ye sapta | tebhiḥ somābhīrakṣaṇa iti | tadapyāmnāyaḥ | digbhrāja ṛtūn karoti | etayaivāvṛtā sahasrasūryatāyā iti vaiśaṃpāyanaḥ | tasyaiṣā bhavati | yaddyāva indra te śataṃśataṃ bhūmīḥ | uta syuḥ | natvā vajrinthsahasraṃ sūryāḥ
1.7.d: सप्त होतार ऋत्विजः । देवा आदित्या ये सप्त । तेभिः सोमाभीरक्षण इति । तदप्याम्नायः । दिग्भ्राज ऋतून् करोति । एतयैवावृता सहस्रसूर्यताया इति वैशंपायनः । तस्यैषा भवति । यद्द्याव इन्द्र ते शतंशतं भूमीः । उत स्युः । नत्वा वज्रिन्थ्सहस्रं सूर्याः
1.7.m: seven hotṛs, the priests; / the gods who are the seven Ādityas, / with them protect Soma.' / That too is sacred tradition. / Shining through the quarters, he makes the seasons. / 'In this very repetition lies the thousandfold nature of the sun,' says Vaiśampāyana. / Regarding that, there is this [verse]: / 'Even if there were a hundred earths for you, O Indra, / and a hundred skies, / yet a thousand suns could not match you, O thunderbolt-wielder,

1.7.s: anunajātamaṣṭa rodasī iti | nānāliṅgatvādṛtūnāṃ nānāsūryatvam | aṣṭau tu vyavasitā iti | sūryamaṇḍalānyaṣṭāta ūrdhvam | teṣāmeṣā bhavati | citraṃ devānāmudagādanīkam | cakṣurmitrasya varuṇasyāgneḥ | āprā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣam | sūrya ātmā jagatastasthuṣaśceti
1.7.d: अनुनजातमष्ट रोदसी इति । नानालिङ्गत्वादृतूनां नानासूर्यत्वम् । अष्टौ तु व्यवसिता इति । सूर्यमण्डलान्यष्टात ऊर्ध्वम् । तेषामेषा भवति । चित्रं देवानामुदगादनीकम् । चक्षुर्मित्रस्य वरुणस्याग्नेः । आप्रा द्यावापृथिवी अन्तरिक्षम् । सूर्य आत्मा जगतस्तस्थुषश्चेति
1.7.m: nor the two worlds, born together.' / Due to the different characteristics of the seasons, there are different suns; / but eight are established. / Eight solar circles are [described] from here onward. / Regarding them, there is this [verse]: / 'The wondrous banner of the gods has arisen, / the eye of Mitra, Varuṇa, and Agni; / it has filled heaven, earth, and intermediate space, / Sūrya, the self of what moves and stands still.'

1.8.s: kvedamabhranniviśate | kvāyaṃ saṃvathsaro mithaḥ | kvāhaḥ kveyandeva rātrī | kva māsā ṛtavaḥ śritāḥ | ardhamāsā muhūrtāḥ | nimeṣāstruṭibhissaha | kvemā āpo niviśante | yadīto yānti saṃprati | kālā apsu niviśante | āpassūrye samāhitāḥ
1.8.d: क्वेदमभ्रन्निविशते । क्वायं संवथ्सरो मिथः । क्वाहः क्वेयन्देव रात्री । क्व मासा ऋतवः श्रिताः । अर्धमासा मुहूर्ताः । निमेषास्त्रुटिभिस्सह । क्वेमा आपो निविशन्ते । यदीतो यान्ति संप्रति । काला अप्सु निविशन्ते । आपस्सूर्ये समाहिताः
1.8.m: Where do these clouds enter? / Where is this year [hidden] reciprocally? / Where is day? Where, O god, is night? / Where do the months, the seasons reside? / The half-months, the muhūrtas, / the twinklings together with the moments? / Where do these waters enter, / when they depart from here now? / The divisions of time enter into the waters; / the waters are established in the sun;

1.8.s: abhrāṇyapaḥ prapadyante | vidyuthsūrye samāhitā | anavarṇe ime bhūmī | iyaṃ cāsau ca rodasī | kiṃsvidatrāntarā bhūtam | yeneme vidhṛte ubhe | viṣṇunā vidhṛte bhūmī | iti vathsasya vedanā | irāvatī dhenumatī hi bhūtam | sūyavasinī manuṣe daśasye
1.8.d: अभ्राण्यपः प्रपद्यन्ते । विद्युथ्सूर्ये समाहिता । अनवर्णे इमे भूमी । इयं चासौ च रोदसी । किंस्विदत्रान्तरा भूतम् । येनेमे विधृते उभे । विष्णुना विधृते भूमी । इति वथ्सस्य वेदना । इरावती धेनुमती हि भूतम् । सूयवसिनी मनुषे दशस्ये
1.8.m: the clouds dissolve into the waters; / lightning is established in the sun. / These two lands are of spotless form, / this [earth] and that sky. / What being was between here, / by which these two are held apart? / The two worlds are held apart by Viṣṇu: / such is the knowledge of Vatsa. / 'Abounding in food, rich in milk, you two beings, / rich in pasture, bestow favor on man;

1.8.s: vyaṣṭabhnādrodasī viṣṇavete | dādhartha pṛthivīmabhito mayūkhaiḥ | kintadviṣṇorbalamāhuḥ | kā dīptiḥ kiṃ parāyaṇam | eko yaddhārayaddevaḥ | rejatī rodasī ubhe | vātādviṣṇorbalamāhuḥ | akṣarāddīptirucyate | tripadāddhārayaddevaḥ | yadviṣṇorekamuttamam
1.8.d: व्यष्टभ्नाद्रोदसी विष्णवेते । दाधर्थ पृथिवीमभितो मयूखैः । किन्तद्विष्णोर्बलमाहुः । का दीप्तिः किं परायणम् । एको यद्धारयद्देवः । रेजती रोदसी उभे । वाताद्विष्णोर्बलमाहुः । अक्षराद्दीप्तिरुच्यते । त्रिपदाद्धारयद्देवः । यद्विष्णोरेकमुत्तमम्
1.8.m: Viṣṇu propped apart these two worlds; / you have supported the earth all around with rays.' / What do they say is the power of Viṣṇu? / What is the radiance? What is the supreme goal? / That one god supported / the two trembling worlds. / From wind, they say, is the power of Viṣṇu; / radiance is said to be from the imperishable syllable. / From the three-footed [verse] the god supported [them], / which is the one highest [step] of Viṣṇu.

1.8.s: agnayo vāyavaścaiva | etadasya parāyaṇam | pṛcchāmi tvā paraṃ mṛtyum | avamaṃ madhyamañcatum | lokañca puṇyapāpānām | etatpṛcchāmi saṃprati | amumāhuḥ paraṃ mṛtyum | pavamānaṃ tu madhyamam | agnirevāvamo mṛtyuḥ | candramāścaturucyate
1.8.d: अग्नयो वायवश्चैव । एतदस्य परायणम् । पृच्छामि त्वा परं मृत्युम् । अवमं मध्यमञ्चतुम् । लोकञ्च पुण्यपापानाम् । एतत्पृच्छामि संप्रति । अमुमाहुः परं मृत्युम् । पवमानं तु मध्यमम् । अग्निरेवावमो मृत्युः । चन्द्रमाश्चतुरुच्यते
1.8.m: The fires and the winds / are his supreme goal. / I ask you about the highest death, / the lowest, the middle, and the fourth; / and the world of the virtuous and the evil— / this I ask you now. / They call that one yonder the highest death, / Pavamāna the middle, / Agni the lowest death, / and the moon is called the fourth.

1.8.s: anābhogāḥ paraṃ mṛtyum | pāpāssaṃyanti sarvadā | ābhogāstveva saṃyanti | yatra puṇyakṛto janāḥ | tato madhyamamāyanti | catumagniṃ ca saṃprati | pṛcchāmi tvā pāpakṛtaḥ | yatra yātayate yamaḥ | tvaṃ nastadbrahman prabrūhi | yadi vetthāsato gṛhān
1.8.d: अनाभोगाः परं मृत्युम् । पापास्संयन्ति सर्वदा । आभोगास्त्वेव संयन्ति । यत्र पुण्यकृतो जनाः । ततो मध्यममायन्ति । चतुमग्निं च संप्रति । पृच्छामि त्वा पापकृतः । यत्र यातयते यमः । त्वं नस्तद्ब्रह्मन् प्रब्रूहि । यदि वेत्थासतो गृहान्
1.8.m: The destitute go always / to the highest death, being evil; / but those of enjoyment go / where people of good deeds dwell. / From there they go to the middle [death], / and now to the fourth and to Agni. / I ask you about the evildoers: / where does Yama mete out punishment? / Tell us that, O brāhmaṇa, / if you know the dwellings of the non-existent.

1.8.s: kaśyapāduditāssūryāḥ | pāpānnirghnanti sarvadā | rodasyorantardeśeṣu | tatra nyasyante vāsavaiḥ | te'śarīrāḥ prapadyante | yathā'puṇyasya karmaṇaḥ | apāṇyapādakeśāsaḥ | tatra te'yonijā janāḥ | mṛtvā punarmṛtyumāpadyante | adyamānāssvakarmabhiḥ
1.8.d: कश्यपादुदितास्सूर्याः । पापान्निर्घ्नन्ति सर्वदा । रोदस्योरन्तर्देशेषु । तत्र न्यस्यन्ते वासवैः । तेऽशरीराः प्रपद्यन्ते । यथाऽपुण्यस्य कर्मणः । अपाण्यपादकेशासः । तत्र तेऽयोनिजा जनाः । मृत्वा पुनर्मृत्युमापद्यन्ते । अद्यमानास्स्वकर्मभिः
1.8.m: The suns that have arisen from Kaśyapa / strike down the wicked constantly. / In the intermediate spaces of heaven and earth / they are cast down there by the Vasus. / Bodiless, they arrive / according to their unmeritorious deeds, / without hands, feet, or hair. / There those people are not born from a womb; / dying, they fall into death again, / being consumed by their own deeds,

1.8.s: āśātikāḥ krimaya iva | tataḥ pūyante vāsavaiḥ | apaitaṃ mṛtyuṃ jayati | ya evaṃ veda | sa khalvaivaṃ vidbrāhmaṇaḥ | dīrghaśruttamo bhavati | kaśyapasyātithissiddhagamanassiddhāgamanaḥ | tasyaiṣā bhavati | ā yasminthsapta vāsavāḥ | rohanti pūrvyā ruhaḥ
1.8.d: आशातिकाः क्रिमय इव । ततः पूयन्ते वासवैः । अपैतं मृत्युं जयति । य एवं वेद । स खल्वैवं विद्ब्राह्मणः । दीर्घश्रुत्तमो भवति । कश्यपस्यातिथिस्सिद्धगमनस्सिद्धागमनः । तस्यैषा भवति । आ यस्मिन्थ्सप्त वासवाः । रोहन्ति पूर्व्या रुहः
1.8.m: like worm-like grubs. / Then they are purified by the Vasus. / He wards off that death and conquers it / who knows thus. / Indeed, a brāhmaṇa who knows thus / becomes one who has heard the most afar, / Kaśyapa's guest whose going is accomplished, whose arrival is accomplished. / Concerning this there is this [verse]: / 'Upon whom the seven Vasus / mount as primeval growths,

1.8.s: ṛṣirha dīrghaśruttamaḥ | indrasya gharmo atithiriti | kaśyapaḥ paśyako bhavati | yathsarvaṃ paripaśyatīti saukṣmyāt | athāgneraṣṭapuruṣasya | tasyaiṣā bhavati | agne naya supathā rāye asmān | viśvāni deva vayunāni vidvān | yuyodhyasmajjuhurāṇamenaḥ | bhūyiṣṭhānte nama uktiṃ vidhemeti
1.8.d: ऋषिर्ह दीर्घश्रुत्तमः । इन्द्रस्य घर्मो अतिथिरिति । कश्यपः पश्यको भवति । यथ्सर्वं परिपश्यतीति सौक्ष्म्यात् । अथाग्नेरष्टपुरुषस्य । तस्यैषा भवति । अग्ने नय सुपथा राये अस्मान् । विश्वानि देव वयुनानि विद्वान् । युयोध्यस्मज्जुहुराणमेनः । भूयिष्ठान्ते नम उक्तिं विधेमेति
1.8.m: the seer is indeed he who has heard the most afar; / the guest is Indra's gharma.' / Kaśyapa is a beholder (paśyaka), / because he sees all around (paripaśyati) on account of his subtlety. / Now of Agni of eight persons: / concerning this there is this [verse]: / 'O Agni, lead us by a good path to wealth, / knowing, O god, all the ways; / remove from us crooked sin; / we offer to you the most ample word of homage.' / [The ten verses] are gathered: gṛhān, svakarmabhiḥ, pūrvyā ruhaḥ, […].

1.9.s: agniśca jātavedāśca | sahojā ajirāprabhuḥ | vaiśvānaro naryāpāśca | paṅktirādhāśca saptamaḥ | visarpevā'ṣṭamo'gnīnām | ete'ṣṭau vasavaḥ kṣitā iti | yathartvevāgnerarcirvarṇaviśeṣāḥ | nīlārciśca pītakārciśceti | atha vāyorekādaśapuruṣasyaikādaśastrīkasya | prabhrājamānā vyavadātāḥ
1.9.d: अग्निश्च जातवेदाश्च । सहोजा अजिराप्रभुः । वैश्वानरो नर्यापाश्च । पङ्क्तिराधाश्च सप्तमः । विसर्पेवाऽष्टमोऽग्नीनाम् । एतेऽष्टौ वसवः क्षिता इति । यथर्त्वेवाग्नेरर्चिर्वर्णविशेषाः । नीलार्चिश्च पीतकार्चिश्चेति । अथ वायोरेकादशपुरुषस्यैकादशस्त्रीकस्य । प्रभ्राजमाना व्यवदाताः
1.9.m: Agni, Jātavedas, / Sahojas, Ajirāprabhu, / Vaiśvānara, Naryāpas, / and Paṅktirādhas the seventh, / Visarpin as the eighth of the Agnis: / these are the eight Vasus, settled. / In accordance with the season indeed are the specific colors of Agni's flame: / blue-flamed and yellow-flamed. / Now of Vāyu who has eleven persons and eleven wives: / The Shining Ones, The Pure,

1.9.s: yāśca vāsukivaidyutāḥ | rajatāḥ paruṣāḥ śyāmāḥ | kapilā atilohitāḥ | ūrdhvā avapatantāśca | vaidyuta ityekādaśa | nainaṃ vaidyuto hinasti | ya evaṃ veda | sa hovāca vyāsaḥ pārāśaryaḥ | vidyudvadhamevāhaṃ mṛtyumaicchamiti | na tvakāmaṃ hanti
1.9.d: याश्च वासुकिवैद्युताः । रजताः परुषाः श्यामाः । कपिला अतिलोहिताः । ऊर्ध्वा अवपतन्ताश्च । वैद्युत इत्येकादश । नैनं वैद्युतो हिनस्ति । य एवं वेद । स होवाच व्यासः पाराशर्यः । विद्युद्वधमेवाहं मृत्युमैच्छमिति । न त्वकामं हन्ति
1.9.m: and those of Vāsuki, The Lightning Ones, / The Silvery, The Rough, The Dark, / The Brown, The Extremely Red, / The Upward, and The Downward-falling: / The Lightning Ones, thus eleven. / Lightning does not harm him / who knows thus. / He, Vyāsa Pārāśarya, indeed said: / 'I desired death only by lightning-strike.' / But it does not kill against one's will

1.9.s: ya evaṃ veda | atha gandharvagaṇāḥ | svānabhrāṭ | aṅghārirbambhāriḥ | hastassuhastaḥ | kṛśānurviśvāvasuḥ | mūrdhanvānthsūryavarcāḥ | kṛtirityekādaśa gandharvagaṇāḥ | devāśca mahādevāḥ | raśmayaśca devā garagiraḥ
1.9.d: य एवं वेद । अथ गन्धर्वगणाः । स्वानभ्राट् । अङ्घारिर्बम्भारिः । हस्तस्सुहस्तः । कृशानुर्विश्वावसुः । मूर्धन्वान्थ्सूर्यवर्चाः । कृतिरित्येकादश गन्धर्वगणाः । देवाश्च महादेवाः । रश्मयश्च देवा गरगिरः
1.9.m: him who knows thus. / Now the hosts of gandharvas: / Svānabhrāj, / Aṅghāri, Bambhāri, / Hasta, Suhasta, / Kṛśānu, Viśvāvasu, / Mūrdhanvat, Sūryavarcas, / [and] Kṛti: thus eleven gandharva hosts. / And the gods and the great gods, / and the rays, gods who swallow poison.

1.9.s: nainaṃ garo hinasti | ya evaṃ veda | gaurīmimāya salilāni takṣatī | ekapadī dvipadī sā catuṣpadī | aṣṭāpadī navapadī babhūvuṣī | sahasrākṣarā parame vyomanniti | vāco viśeṣaṇam | atha nigadavyākhyātāḥ | tānanukramiṣyāmaḥ | varāhavassvatapasaḥ
1.9.d: नैनं गरो हिनस्ति । य एवं वेद । गौरीमिमाय सलिलानि तक्षती । एकपदी द्विपदी सा चतुष्पदी । अष्टापदी नवपदी बभूवुषी । सहस्राक्षरा परमे व्योमन्निति । वाचो विशेषणम् । अथ निगदव्याख्याताः । ताननुक्रमिष्यामः । वराहवस्स्वतपसः
1.9.m: Poison does not harm him / who knows thus. / 'The buffalo cow lowed, fashioning the waters, / one-footed, two-footed, she four-footed, / having become eight-footed, nine-footed, / thousand-syllabled in the highest firmament': / this is a qualification of speech. / Now those explained by recitation: / we shall enumerate them. / Varāhavas, Svatapas,

1.9.s: vidyunmahaso dhūpayaḥ | śvāpayo gṛhamedhāścetyete | ye ceme'śimividviṣaḥ | parjanyāssapta pṛthivīmabhivarṣanti | vṛṣṭibhiriti | etayaiva vibhaktiviparītāḥ | saptabhirvātairudīritāḥ | amūn lokānabhivarṣanti | teṣāmeṣā bhavati | samānametadudakam
1.9.d: विद्युन्महसो धूपयः । श्वापयो गृहमेधाश्चेत्येते । ये चेमेऽशिमिविद्विषः । पर्जन्यास्सप्त पृथिवीमभिवर्षन्ति । वृष्टिभिरिति । एतयैव विभक्तिविपरीताः । सप्तभिर्वातैरुदीरिताः । अमून् लोकानभिवर्षन्ति । तेषामेषा भवति । समानमेतदुदकम्
1.9.m: Vidyunmahas, Dhūpaya, / Śvāpaya, and Gṛhamedha: these, / and those here who are Aśimividviṣas. / Seven Parjanyas rain upon the earth / with showers. / Reversed in case-ending, / impelled by seven winds, / they rain upon those worlds. / Concerning them there is this [verse]: / 'This same water

1.9.s: uccaityavacāhabhiḥ | bhūmiṃ parjanyā jinvanti | divaṃ jinvantyagnaya iti | yadakṣaraṃ bhūtakṛtam | viśve devā upāsate | maharṣimasya goptāram | jamadagnimakurvata | jamadagnirāpyāyate | chandobhiścaturuttaraiḥ | rājñassomasya tṛptāsaḥ
1.9.d: उच्चैत्यवचाहभिः । भूमिं पर्जन्या जिन्वन्ति । दिवं जिन्वन्त्यग्नय इति । यदक्षरं भूतकृतम् । विश्वे देवा उपासते । महर्षिमस्य गोप्तारम् । जमदग्निमकुर्वत । जमदग्निराप्यायते । छन्दोभिश्चतुरुत्तरैः । राज्ञस्सोमस्य तृप्तासः
1.9.m: goes up and down day by day; / the Parjanyas invigorate the earth; / the Agnis invigorate the sky.' / The syllable which creates beings, / which all the gods revere: / they made the great seer Jamadagni / its guardian. / Jamadagni swells / through the metres increasing by four. / Satisfied with King Soma,

1.9.s: brahmaṇā vīryāvatā | śivā naḥ pradiśo diśaḥ | tacchaṃyorāvṛṇīmahe | gātuṃ yajñāya | gātuṃ yajñapataye | daivīsvastirastu naḥ | svastirmānuṣebhyaḥ | ūrdhvaṃ jigātu bheṣajam | śanno astu dvipade | śaṃ catuṣpade | somapā asomapā iti nigadavyākhyātāḥ
1.9.d: ब्रह्मणा वीर्यावता । शिवा नः प्रदिशो दिशः । तच्छंयोरावृणीमहे । गातुं यज्ञाय । गातुं यज्ञपतये । दैवीस्वस्तिरस्तु नः । स्वस्तिर्मानुषेभ्यः । ऊर्ध्वं जिगातु भेषजम् । शन्नो अस्तु द्विपदे । शं चतुष्पदे । सोमपा असोमपा इति निगदव्याख्याताः
1.9.m: with potent brahman: / 'Auspicious to us be the intermediate directions and the directions. / We choose that blessing and solace, / path for the sacrifice, / path for the lord of the sacrifice; / divine well-being be ours, / well-being to mortals; / upward may the medicine go; / peace be to our two-footed, / peace to our four-footed.' / Somapā3 and Asomapā3 are explained by recitation. / [Anuvāka ends:] vyavadātāḥ, hanti, garagiraḥ, tapasaḥ, udakam, tṛptāsaḥ, catuṣpade, ekaṃ ca.

1.10.s: sahasravṛdiyaṃ bhūmiḥ | paraṃ vyoma sahasravṛt | aśvinā bhujyū nāsatyā | viśvasya jagataspatī | jāyā bhūmiḥ patirvyoma | mithunantā aturyathuḥ | putro bṛhaspatī rudraḥ | saramā iti strīpumam | śukraṃ vāmanyadyajataṃ vāmanyat | viṣurūpe ahanī dyauriva sthaḥ
1.10.d: सहस्रवृदियं भूमिः । परं व्योम सहस्रवृत् । अश्विना भुज्यू नासत्या । विश्वस्य जगतस्पती । जाया भूमिः पतिर्व्योम । मिथुनन्ता अतुर्यथुः । पुत्रो बृहस्पती रुद्रः । सरमा इति स्त्रीपुमम् । शुक्रं वामन्यद्यजतं वामन्यत् । विषुरूपे अहनी द्यौरिव स्थः
1.10.m: This earth is thousandfold; / the highest firmament is thousandfold. / The Aśvins, Bhujyu, Nāsatyas, / lords of the whole moving world. / The earth is wife, the firmament is husband; / you two advanced toward that couple. / The son is Bṛhaspati, Rudra, / Saramā: thus female and male. / 'Bright is one [form] of you, worthy of sacrifice is the other; / you two are of diverse forms like Day and Heaven.

1.10.s: viśvā hi māyā avathaḥ svadhāvantau | bhadrā vāṃ pūṣaṇāviha rātirastu | vāsātyau citrau jagato nidhānau | dyāvābhūmī carathaḥ saṃ sakhāyau | tāvaśvinā rāsabhāśvā havaṃ me | śubhaspatī āgataṃ sūryayā saha | tyugroha bhujyumaśvinodameghe | rayinna kaścinmamṛvāṃ avāhāḥ | tamūhathurnaubhirātmanvatībhiḥ | antarikṣapruḍbhirapodakābhiḥ
1.10.d: विश्वा हि माया अवथः स्वधावन्तौ । भद्रा वां पूषणाविह रातिरस्तु । वासात्यौ चित्रौ जगतो निधानौ । द्यावाभूमी चरथः सं सखायौ । तावश्विना रासभाश्वा हवं मे । शुभस्पती आगतं सूर्यया सह । त्युग्रोह भुज्युमश्विनोदमेघे । रयिन्न कश्चिन्ममृवां अवाहाः । तमूहथुर्नौभिरात्मन्वतीभिः । अन्तरिक्षप्रुड्भिरपोदकाभिः
1.10.m: For, rich in autonomy, you protect all wondrous powers; / O Pūṣans, may your auspicious bounty be here. / O Vāsatyas, wondrous, deposits of the world, / you two friends wander together through heaven and earth. / O Aśvins with ass-drawn chariots, come to my call, / lords of beauty, together with Sūryā. / Tugra abandoned Bhujyu in the cloud of waters, / as someone who has died [leaves] wealth; / you two carried him in self-propelled boats / swimming through the intermediate space, waterless,

1.10.s: tisraḥ kṣapastrirahā'tivrajadbhiḥ | nāsatyā bhujyumūhathuḥ pataṅgaiḥ | samudrasya dhanvannārdrasya pāre | tribhīrathaiḥ śatapadbhiḥ ṣaḍaśvaiḥ | savitāraṃ vitanvantam | anubadhnāti śāmbaraḥ | āpapūruṣambaraścaiva | savitā'repaso bhavat | tyaṃ sutṛptaṃ viditvaiva | bahusoma giraṃ vaśī
1.10.d: तिस्रः क्षपस्त्रिरहाऽतिव्रजद्भिः । नासत्या भुज्युमूहथुः पतङ्गैः । समुद्रस्य धन्वन्नार्द्रस्य पारे । त्रिभीरथैः शतपद्भिः षडश्वैः । सवितारं वितन्वन्तम् । अनुबध्नाति शाम्बरः । आपपूरुषम्बरश्चैव । सविताऽरेपसो भवत् । त्यं सुतृप्तं विदित्वैव । बहुसोम गिरं वशी
1.10.m: traveling for three nights and three days, / O Nāsatyas, you carried Bhujyu with winged [craft], / on the shore of the ocean, in the arid desert, / with three six-horsed, hundred-footed chariots.' / Śāmbara binds / Savitṛ who extends [his light]. / Savitṛ purified the man and his garment, / and became free from stain. / Knowing him to be well-satisfied, / the ruler of speech, rich in soma,

1.10.s: anveti tugro vakriyāntam | āyasūyānthsomatṛpsuṣu | sa saṃgrāmastamodyo'tyotaḥ | vāco gāḥ pipāti tat | sa tadgobhisstavā'tyetyanye | rakṣasā'nanvitāśca ye | anveti parivṛtyāstaḥ | evametau stho aśvinā | te ete dyuḥpṛthivyoḥ | aharahargarbhandadhāthe
1.10.d: अन्वेति तुग्रो वक्रियान्तम् । आयसूयान्थ्सोमतृप्सुषु । स संग्रामस्तमोद्योऽत्योतः । वाचो गाः पिपाति तत् । स तद्गोभिस्स्तवाऽत्येत्यन्ये । रक्षसाऽनन्विताश्च ये । अन्वेति परिवृत्यास्तः । एवमेतौ स्थो अश्विना । ते एते द्युःपृथिव्योः । अहरहर्गर्भन्दधाथे
1.10.m: Tugra pursues him who acts crookedly, / those who envy iron among those desiring soma-satisfaction. / That battle is pierced by darkness; / it guards the cows of speech. / With those cows, he crosses over through praise, and the others / who are not accompanied by rakṣases. / Turning around, they pursue the home. / Thus are you two, O Aśvins. / You two place the embryo in heaven and earth day by day.

1.10.s: tayoretau vathsāvahorātre | pṛthivyā ahaḥ | divo rātriḥ | tā avisṛṣṭau | dampatī eva bhavataḥ | tayoretau vathsau | agniścādityaśca | rātrervathsaḥ | śveta ādityaḥ | ahno'gniḥ
1.10.d: तयोरेतौ वथ्सावहोरात्रे । पृथिव्या अहः । दिवो रात्रिः । ता अविसृष्टौ । दम्पती एव भवतः । तयोरेतौ वथ्सौ । अग्निश्चादित्यश्च । रात्रेर्वथ्सः । श्वेत आदित्यः । अह्नोऽग्निः
1.10.m: Of those two, day and night are these two calves: / of the earth, day; / of the sky, night. / Those two, unseparated, / are indeed a wedded pair. / Of those two, these two are the calves: / Agni and Āditya. / Night's calf is / the white Āditya; / Day's [calf] is Agni,

1.10.s: tāmro aruṇaḥ | tā avisṛṣṭau | dampatī eva bhavataḥ | tayoretau vathsau | vṛtraśca vaidyutaśca | agnervṛtraḥ | vaidyuta ādityasya | tā avisṛṣṭau | dampatī eva bhavataḥ | tayoretau vathsau
1.10.d: ताम्रो अरुणः । ता अविसृष्टौ । दम्पती एव भवतः । तयोरेतौ वथ्सौ । वृत्रश्च वैद्युतश्च । अग्नेर्वृत्रः । वैद्युत आदित्यस्य । ता अविसृष्टौ । दम्पती एव भवतः । तयोरेतौ वथ्सौ
1.10.m: copper-colored and reddish. / Those two, unseparated, / are indeed a wedded pair. / Of those two, these two are the calves: / Vṛtra and the lightning-born. / Agni's [calf] is Vṛtra; / the lightning-born is Āditya's. / Those two, unseparated, / are indeed a wedded pair. / Of those two, these two are the calves:

1.10.s: uṣmā ca nīhāraśca | vṛtrasyoṣmā | vaidyutasya nīhāraḥ | tau tāveva pratipadyete | seyaṃ rātrī garbhiṇī putreṇa saṃvasati | tasyā vā etadulbaṇam | yadrātrau raśmayaḥ | yathā gorgarbhiṇyā ulbaṇam | evametasyā ulbaṇam | prajayiṣṇuḥ prajayā ca paśubhiśca bhavati | ya evaṃ veda | etamudyantamapiyantaṃ ceti | ādityaḥ puṇyasya vathsaḥ | atha pavitrāṃgirasaḥ
1.10.d: उष्मा च नीहारश्च । वृत्रस्योष्मा । वैद्युतस्य नीहारः । तौ तावेव प्रतिपद्येते । सेयं रात्री गर्भिणी पुत्रेण संवसति । तस्या वा एतदुल्बणम् । यद्रात्रौ रश्मयः । यथा गोर्गर्भिण्या उल्बणम् । एवमेतस्या उल्बणम् । प्रजयिष्णुः प्रजया च पशुभिश्च भवति । य एवं वेद । एतमुद्यन्तमपियन्तं चेति । आदित्यः पुण्यस्य वथ्सः । अथ पवित्रांगिरसः
1.10.m: Heat and mist: heat belongs to Vṛtra; mist belongs to the lightning-fire. Those two, indeed, obtain them. This night, pregnant, lives together with her son. This is her fetal membrane: the rays at night. Just as there is a fetal membrane of a pregnant cow, / so is there a fetal membrane of this [night]. He becomes prolific in offspring and in cattle who knows thus: 'he who goes forth and goes down.' Āditya is the calf of merit. Now, the purifying Aṅgirases. / 'You two are [stationed] by the waters, you rulers hold [the world]; Agni...'—of those two these are the two calves; it becomes four.

1.11.s: pavitravantaḥ parivājamāsate | pitaiṣāṃ pratno abhirakṣati vratam | mahassamudraṃ varuṇastirodadhe | dhīrā icchekurdharuṇeṣvārabham | pavitraṃ te vitataṃ brahmaṇaspate | prabhurgātrāṇi paryeṣi viśvataḥ | ataptatanūrna tadāmo aśnute | śṛtāsa idvahantastathsamāśata | brahmā devānām | asatassadye tatakṣuḥ
1.11.d: पवित्रवन्तः परिवाजमासते । पितैषां प्रत्नो अभिरक्षति व्रतम् । महस्समुद्रं वरुणस्तिरोदधे । धीरा इच्छेकुर्धरुणेष्वारभम् । पवित्रं ते विततं ब्रह्मणस्पते । प्रभुर्गात्राणि पर्येषि विश्वतः । अतप्ततनूर्न तदामो अश्नुते । शृतास इद्वहन्तस्तथ्समाशत । ब्रह्मा देवानाम् । असतस्सद्ये ततक्षुः
1.11.m: Possessing the filter, they sit around the prize of strength; their ancient father guards the observance. Varuṇa concealed the great ocean; the wise were able to take hold [of it] in the foundations. / Your filter is stretched out, O Brahmaṇaspati; sovereign, you encompass the limbs from every side. The one whose body is not heated, the raw one, does not attain that; only the cooked, bearing it, have reached it together. Brahmā of the gods; they fashioned being from non-being;

1.11.s: ṛṣayassaptātriśca yat | sarve'trayo agastyaśca | nakṣatraiḥ śaṃkṛto'vasan | atha savituḥ śyāvāśvasyāvartikāmasya | amī ya ṛkṣā nihitāsa uccā | naktaṃ dadṛśre kuhaciddiveyuḥ | adabdhāni varuṇasya vratāni | vicākaśaccandramā nakṣatrameti | tathsaviturvareṇyam | bhargo devasya dhīmahi
1.11.d: ऋषयस्सप्तात्रिश्च यत् । सर्वेऽत्रयो अगस्त्यश्च । नक्षत्रैः शंकृतोऽवसन् । अथ सवितुः श्यावाश्वस्यावर्तिकामस्य । अमी य ऋक्षा निहितास उच्चा । नक्तं ददृश्रे कुहचिद्दिवेयुः । अदब्धानि वरुणस्य व्रतानि । विचाकशच्चन्द्रमा नक्षत्रमेति । तथ्सवितुर्वरेण्यम् । भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि
1.11.m: and that the seers were seven and Atri; all the Atris and Agastya, cheered by the constellations, dwelt. Now of Savitṛ, of Śyāvāśva, of his quail: 'These bears that are placed high above, / seen at night, where have they gone by day? Varuṇa's ordinances are unbroken; shining brightly, the moon goes among the constellations.' 'That excellent [splendor] of Savitṛ, / the radiance of the god, we meditate upon,

1.11.s: dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt | tathsaviturvṛṇīmahe | vayandevasya bhojanam | śreṣṭhaṃsarvadhātamam | turaṃ bhagasya dhīmahi | apāgūhata savitā tṛbhīn | sarvāndivo andhasaḥ | naktantānyabhavandṛśe | asthyasthnā saṃbhaviṣyāmaḥ | nāma nāmaiva nāma me
1.11.d: धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् । तथ्सवितुर्वृणीमहे । वयन्देवस्य भोजनम् । श्रेष्ठंसर्वधातमम् । तुरं भगस्य धीमहि । अपागूहत सविता तृभीन् । सर्वान्दिवो अन्धसः । नक्तन्तान्यभवन्दृशे । अस्थ्यस्थ्ना संभविष्यामः । नाम नामैव नाम मे
1.11.m: who may inspire our thoughts.' 'That we choose of Savitṛ; we [choose] the enjoyment of the god, / the best, bestowing all; swift, we meditate upon [the wealth] of Bhaga.' Savitṛ concealed the stars, all of them from the blind sky; at night they became visible. Bone by bone we shall come together; / my name is indeed name by name.

1.11.s: napuṃsakaṃ pumāṃstryasmi | sthāvaro'smyatha jaṅgamaḥ | yaje'yakṣi yaṣṭāhe ca | mayā bhūtānyayakṣata | paśavo mama bhūtāni | anūbandhyo'smyahaṃ vibhuḥ | striyassatīḥ | tā u me puṃsa āhuḥ | paśyadakṣaṇvānnavicetadandhaḥ | kaviryaḥ putrassa imā ciketa
1.11.d: नपुंसकं पुमांस्त्र्यस्मि । स्थावरोऽस्म्यथ जङ्गमः । यजेऽयक्षि यष्टाहे च । मया भूतान्ययक्षत । पशवो मम भूतानि । अनूबन्ध्योऽस्म्यहं विभुः । स्त्रियस्सतीः । ता उ मे पुंस आहुः । पश्यदक्षण्वान्नविचेतदन्धः । कविर्यः पुत्रस्स इमा चिकेत
1.11.m: I am neuter, male, female; I am stationary and moving. / I sacrifice, I have sacrificed, and I shall sacrifice; by me the beings have sacrificed. The beings are my cattle; I am the all-pervading [victim] to be bound afterward. Being females, / they have spoken of them to me as males. The one with eyes saw, the blind one did not discern; the poet who is the son, he knows these.

1.11.s: yastā vijānāthsavituḥ pitā sat | andho maṇimavindat | tamanaṅgulirāvayat | agrīvaḥ pratyamuñcat | tamajihvā asaścata | ūrdhvamūlamavākchākham | vṛkṣaṃ yo veda samprati | na sa jātu janaḥ śraddadhyāt | mṛtyurmā mārayāditiḥ | hasitaṃ ruditaṃgītam
1.11.d: यस्ता विजानाथ्सवितुः पिता सत् । अन्धो मणिमविन्दत् । तमनङ्गुलिरावयत् । अग्रीवः प्रत्यमुञ्चत् । तमजिह्वा असश्चत । ऊर्ध्वमूलमवाक्छाखम् । वृक्षं यो वेद सम्प्रति । न स जातु जनः श्रद्दध्यात् । मृत्युर्मा मारयादितिः । हसितं रुदितंगीतम्
1.11.m: He who discerns these shall be the father of Savitṛ. The blind one found the jewel; the fingerless one threaded it; the neckless one fastened it on; the tongueless one praised it. Rooted above, branching downward— / the tree which one knows rightly, that person would never believe: 'Death shall cause me to die.' Laughter, weeping, singing,

1.11.s: vīṇāpaṇavalāsitam | mṛtaṃjīvaṃ ca yatkiṃcit | aṅgāni sneva viddhi tat | atṛṣyaṃstṛṣya dhyāyat | asmājjātā me mithū caran | putro nirṛtyā vaidehaḥ | acetā yaśca cetanaḥ | sa taṃ maṇimavindat | so'naṅgulirāvayat | so'grīvaḥ pratyamuñcat
1.11.d: वीणापणवलासितम् । मृतंजीवं च यत्किंचित् । अङ्गानि स्नेव विद्धि तत् । अतृष्यंस्तृष्य ध्यायत् । अस्माज्जाता मे मिथू चरन् । पुत्रो निरृत्या वैदेहः । अचेता यश्च चेतनः । स तं मणिमविन्दत् । सोऽनङ्गुलिरावयत् । सोऽग्रीवः प्रत्यमुञ्चत्
1.11.m: the sound of the vīṇā and the paṇava drum, whatever is dead and whatever is living—know that as his very limbs. Not thirsting, thirsting, meditating; born from this, going in pairs with me, / the son of Nirṛti, the body-less one, who is unconscious and who is conscious: he found that jewel, / he without fingers threaded it, he without a neck fastened it on,

1.11.s: so'jihvo asaścata | naitamṛṣiṃ viditvā nagaraṃ praviśet | yadi praviśet | mithau caritvā praviśet | tathsambhavasya vratam | ātamagne rathantiṣṭha | ekāśvamekayojanam | ekacakramekadhuram | vātadhrājigatiṃ vibho | na riṣyati na vyathate
1.11.d: सोऽजिह्वो असश्चत । नैतमृषिं विदित्वा नगरं प्रविशेत् । यदि प्रविशेत् । मिथौ चरित्वा प्रविशेत् । तथ्सम्भवस्य व्रतम् । आतमग्ने रथन्तिष्ठ । एकाश्वमेकयोजनम् । एकचक्रमेकधुरम् । वातध्राजिगतिं विभो । न रिष्यति न व्यथते
1.11.m: he without a tongue praised it. Having known this seer, one should not enter a city. If one should enter, / one should enter having engaged in sexual union: that is the observance of generation. Mount the chariot, O Agni, with one horse, one yoking, / with one wheel, with one pole, moving with the rush of wind, O all-pervading one! It does not come to harm, it does not totter,

1.11.s: nāsyākṣo yātu sajjati | yacchvetānrohitāṃścāgneḥ | rathe yuktvā'dhitiṣṭhati | ekayā ca daśabhiśca svabhūte | dvābhyāmiṣṭaye viṃśatyā ca | tisṛbhiśca vahase triṃśatā ca | niyudbhirvāyavihitā vimuñca
1.11.d: नास्याक्षो यातु सज्जति । यच्छ्वेतान्रोहितांश्चाग्नेः । रथे युक्त्वाऽधितिष्ठति । एकया च दशभिश्च स्वभूते । द्वाभ्यामिष्टये विंशत्या च । तिसृभिश्च वहसे त्रिंशता च । नियुद्भिर्वायविहिता विमुञ्च
1.11.m: its axle does not stick in the course, when one mounts having yoked the white and ruddy [steeds] of Agni to the chariot. 'With one and with ten, O self-existent one; with two and with twenty for the sacrifice; and with three and with thirty you carry [us] along; unyoke, O Vāyu, the horses assigned here!' / 'They fashioned', 'we meditate', 'my name', 'he knows', 'singing', 'he fastened on', 'does not totter', and seven.

1.12.s: ātanuṣva pratanuṣva | uddhamā''dhama sandhama | āditye candravarṇānām | garbhamādhehi yaḥ pumān | itassiktaṃ sūryagatam | candramase rasaṅkṛdhi | vārādañjanayāgre'gnim | ya eko rudra ucyate | asaṃkhyātāssahasrāṇi | smaryate na ca dṛśyate
1.12.d: आतनुष्व प्रतनुष्व । उद्धमा'ऽधम सन्धम । आदित्ये चन्द्रवर्णानाम् । गर्भमाधेहि यः पुमान् । इतस्सिक्तं सूर्यगतम् । चन्द्रमसे रसङ्कृधि । वारादञ्जनयाग्रेऽग्निम् । य एको रुद्र उच्यते । असंख्यातास्सहस्राणि । स्मर्यते न च दृश्यते
1.12.m: Spread out, stretch forth! Blow upward, blow down, blow together! In Āditya, place the embryo of those having the color of the moon, which is male. / Make the sap that is poured from here, gone into the sun, into the moon! Generate in the water, in the eye, in Agni, he who is called the one Rudra! / Countless thousands: it is remembered, and it is not seen.

1.12.s: evametannibodhata | āmandrairindra haribhiḥ | yāhi mayūraromabhiḥ | mā tvā kecinniyemurinna pāśinaḥ | dadhanveva tā ihi | mā mandrairindra haribhiḥ | yāmi mayūraromabhiḥ | mā mā kecinniyemurinna pāśinaḥ | nidhanveva tāṃ imi | aṇubhiśca mahadbhiśca
1.12.d: एवमेतन्निबोधत । आमन्द्रैरिन्द्र हरिभिः । याहि मयूररोमभिः । मा त्वा केचिन्नियेमुरिन्न पाशिनः । दधन्वेव ता इहि । मा मन्द्रैरिन्द्र हरिभिः । यामि मयूररोमभिः । मा मा केचिन्नियेमुरिन्न पाशिनः । निधन्वेव तां इमि । अणुभिश्च महद्भिश्च
1.12.m: Understand it thus! 'Come, O Indra, with your gladdening bay horses, with hair like peacock feathers! / Let no trappers hold you back as with snares; bypass them as across a desert!' 'With my gladdening bay horses, with hair like peacock feathers, I come; / let no trappers hold me back as with snares; I bypass them as across a desert!' With the minute and with the great,

1.12.s: nighṛṣvairasamāyutaiḥ | kālairharitvamāpannaiḥ | indrāyāhi sahasrayuk | agnirvibhrāṣṭivasanaḥ | vāyuḥ śvetasikadrukaḥ | saṃvathsaro viṣūvarṇaiḥ | nityāste'nucarāstava | subrahmaṇyoṃ subrahmaṇyoṃ subrahmaṇyom | indrāgaccha hariva āgaccha medhātitheḥ | meṣa vṛṣaṇaśvasya mene
1.12.d: निघृष्वैरसमायुतैः । कालैर्हरित्वमापन्नैः । इन्द्रायाहि सहस्रयुक् । अग्निर्विभ्राष्टिवसनः । वायुः श्वेतसिकद्रुकः । संवथ्सरो विषूवर्णैः । नित्यास्तेऽनुचरास्तव । सुब्रह्मण्यों सुब्रह्मण्यों सुब्रह्मण्योम् । इन्द्रागच्छ हरिव आगच्छ मेधातिथेः । मेष वृषणश्वस्य मेने
1.12.m: with the rubbing [sparks], unjoined, with times that have attained the state of bay steeds—come, O Indra, yoked with a thousand! / Agni is clad in radiant light; Vāyu is the white, sweet-sounding one; the year has varied colors; they are your constant attendants. Subrahmaṇyom, Subrahmaṇyom, Subrahmaṇyom! / Come, Indra! Come, owner of the bay steeds, ram of Medhātithi! Lover of Vṛṣaṇaśva's daughter!

1.12.s: gaurāvaskandinnahalyāyai jāra | kauśikabrāhmaṇa gautamabruvāṇa | aruṇāśvā ihāgatāḥ | vasavaḥ pṛthivikṣitaḥ | aṣṭau digvāsaso'gnayaḥ | agniśca jātavedāścetyete | tāmrāśvāstāmrarathāḥ | tāmravarṇāstathā'sitāḥ | daṇḍahastāḥ khādagdataḥ | ito rudrāḥ parāṅgatāḥ
1.12.d: गौरावस्कन्दिन्नहल्यायै जार । कौशिकब्राह्मण गौतमब्रुवाण । अरुणाश्वा इहागताः । वसवः पृथिविक्षितः । अष्टौ दिग्वाससोऽग्नयः । अग्निश्च जातवेदाश्चेत्येते । ताम्राश्वास्ताम्ररथाः । ताम्रवर्णास्तथाऽसिताः । दण्डहस्ताः खादग्दतः । इतो रुद्राः पराङ्गताः
1.12.m: Leaper upon the white cow, paramour of Ahalyā! O Kauśika brāhmaṇa, calling yourself Gautama! The ruddy-horsed ones have arrived here, the Vasus dwelling on the earth: the eight fires clad in the quarters of space, / namely Agni and Jātavedas, and so forth. Having copper horses, copper chariots, copper-colored and also black, with staves in hand, biting, eating—from here the Rudras have gone away.

1.12.s: uktaṃ sthānaṃ pramāṇañca pura ita | bṛhaspatiśca savitā ca | viśvarūpairihāgatām | rathenodakavartmanā | apsuṣā iti taddvayoḥ | ukto veṣo vāsāṃsi ca | kālāvayavānāmitaḥ pratīcyā | vāsātyā ityaśvinoḥ | ko'ntarikṣe śabdaṅkarotīti | vāsiṣṭho rauhiṇo mīmāṃsāñcakre | tasyaiṣā bhavati | vāśreva vidyuditi | brahmaṇa udaraṇamasi | brahmaṇa udīraṇamasi | brahmaṇa āstaraṇamasi | brahmaṇa upastaraṇamasi
1.12.d: उक्तं स्थानं प्रमाणञ्च पुर इत । बृहस्पतिश्च सविता च । विश्वरूपैरिहागताम् । रथेनोदकवर्त्मना । अप्सुषा इति तद्द्वयोः । उक्तो वेषो वासांसि च । कालावयवानामितः प्रतीच्या । वासात्या इत्यश्विनोः । कोऽन्तरिक्षे शब्दङ्करोतीति । वासिष्ठो रौहिणो मीमांसाञ्चक्रे । तस्यैषा भवति । वाश्रेव विद्युदिति । ब्रह्मण उदरणमसि । ब्रह्मण उदीरणमसि । ब्रह्मण आस्तरणमसि । ब्रह्मण उपस्तरणमसि
1.12.m: The place and measure have been stated eastward from here. 'And Bṛhaspati and Savitṛ / have arrived here in manifold forms with a chariot whose course is water; conquerors in the waters'—that is of the two. / The attire and garments of the parts of time westward from here have been stated. 'Belonging to the dawn' is of the two Aśvins. / 'Who makes a sound in the intermediate space?'—the son of Vasiṣṭha, Rauhiṇa, pondered. Pertaining to him is this: 'Like a lowing [cow], lightning...' You are the arising of brahman; you are the raising up of brahman; you are the spreading out of brahman; you are the bedding of brahman. / 'And it is seen', 'lover', 'gone away', 'he made', and six. / (Depart, pregnant women!)

1.13.s: aṣṭayonīmaṣṭaputrām | aṣṭapatnīmimāṃ mahīm | ahaṃ veda na me mṛtyuḥ | nacāmṛtyuraghā'harat | aṣṭayonyaṣṭaputram | aṣṭapadidamantarikṣam | ahaṃ veda na me mṛtyuḥ | nacāmṛtyuraghā'harat | aṣṭayonīmaṣṭaputrām | aṣṭapatnīmamūndivam
1.13.d: अष्टयोनीमष्टपुत्राम् । अष्टपत्नीमिमां महीम् । अहं वेद न मे मृत्युः । नचामृत्युरघाऽहरत् । अष्टयोन्यष्टपुत्रम् । अष्टपदिदमन्तरिक्षम् । अहं वेद न मे मृत्युः । नचामृत्युरघाऽहरत् । अष्टयोनीमष्टपुत्राम् । अष्टपत्नीममून्दिवम्
1.13.m:
Having eight wombs, eight sons, having eight husbands, this great [earth]—I know [her]; death is not mine, / nor has non-death seized my sin. Having eight wombs, eight sons, eight feet is this intermediate space—I know [it]; death is not mine, / nor has non-death seized my sin. Having eight wombs, eight sons, having eight husbands is yonder sky—

I know [it]; death is not mine, nor has non-death seized my sin. 'Well-protecting, the great...', 'Aditi is the sky, Aditi is the intermediate space, Aditi is the mother, she is the father, she is the son; / the All-gods are Aditi, the five peoples; Aditi is what is born, Aditi is what will be born.' The eight sons of Aditi who were born from her body—with seven she approached the gods;

1.13.s: ahaṃ veda na me mṛtyuḥ | nacāmṛtyuraghā''harat | sutrāmāṇaṃ mahīmūṣu | aditirdyauraditirantarikṣam | aditirmātā sa pitā sa putraḥ | viśve devā aditiḥ pañcajanāḥ | aditirjātamaditirjanitvam | aṣṭau putrāso aditeḥ | ye jātāstanvaḥ pari | devāṃ upapraithsaptabhiḥ
1.13.d: अहं वेद न मे मृत्युः । नचामृत्युरघा'ऽहरत् । सुत्रामाणं महीमूषु । अदितिर्द्यौरदितिरन्तरिक्षम् । अदितिर्माता स पिता स पुत्रः । विश्वे देवा अदितिः पञ्चजनाः । अदितिर्जातमदितिर्जनित्वम् । अष्टौ पुत्रासो अदितेः । ये जातास्तन्वः परि । देवां उपप्रैथ्सप्तभिः

1.13.s: parā mārtāṇḍamāsyat | saptabhiḥ putrairaditiḥ | upapraitpūrvyaṃ yugam | prajāyai mṛtyave tat | parā mārtāṇḍamābharaditi | tānanukramiṣyāmaḥ | mitraśca varuṇaśca | dhātā cāryamā ca | aṃśaśca bhagaśca | indraśca vivasvāṃścetyete | hiraṇyagarbho haṃsaḥ śuciṣat | brahmajajñānaṃ taditpadamiti | garbhaḥ prājāpatyaḥ | atha puruṣaḥ saptapuruṣaḥ
1.13.d: परा मार्ताण्डमास्यत् । सप्तभिः पुत्रैरदितिः । उपप्रैत्पूर्व्यं युगम् । प्रजायै मृत्यवे तत् । परा मार्ताण्डमाभरदिति । ताननुक्रमिष्यामः । मित्रश्च वरुणश्च । धाता चार्यमा च । अंशश्च भगश्च । इन्द्रश्च विवस्वांश्चेत्येते । हिरण्यगर्भो हंसः शुचिषत् । ब्रह्मजज्ञानं तदित्पदमिति । गर्भः प्राजापत्यः । अथ पुरुषः सप्तपुरुषः
1.13.m: She cast aside Mārtāṇḍa. / With seven sons Aditi / approached the former age; / for procreation and for death / she brought Mārtāṇḍa back thither. / We shall enumerate them: / Mitra and Varuṇa, / Dhātṛ and Aryaman, / Aṃśa and Bhaga, / Indra and Vivasvat—these [are they]. / 'The golden womb', 'The swan seated in the pure', / 'Brahman born first', 'That very step'— / [these make] the embryo pertaining to Prajāpati. / Now the Puruṣa consisting of seven persons. / [Index: amūndivaṃ saptabhirete catvāri ca || 13 || (In their proper place, the pregnant bricks)]

1.14.s: yo'sau tapannudeti | sa sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ prāṇānādāyodeti | mā me prajāyā mā paśūnām | mā mama prāṇānādāyodagāḥ | asau yo'stameti | sa sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ prāṇānādāyāstameti | mā me prajāyā mā paśūnām | mā mama prāṇānādāyā'staṅgāḥ | asau ya āpūryati | sa sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ prāṇairāpūryati
1.14.d: योऽसौ तपन्नुदेति । स सर्वेषां भूतानां प्राणानादायोदेति । मा मे प्रजाया मा पशूनाम् । मा मम प्राणानादायोदगाः । असौ योऽस्तमेति । स सर्वेषां भूतानां प्राणानादायास्तमेति । मा मे प्रजाया मा पशूनाम् । मा मम प्राणानादायाऽस्तङ्गाः । असौ य आपूर्यति । स सर्वेषां भूतानां प्राणैरापूर्यति
1.14.m:
That one who rises burning, he rises taking away the vital breaths of all beings. Do not rise taking away the vital breaths of my offspring, nor of my cattle, nor of mine! That one who sets, he sets taking away the vital breaths of all beings. Do not set taking away the vital breaths of my offspring, nor of my cattle, nor of mine! That one who waxes full, he waxes full with the vital breaths of all beings.

Do not wax full with the vital breaths of my offspring, nor of my cattle, nor of mine! That one who wanes, he wanes with the vital breaths of all beings. Do not wane with the vital breaths of my offspring, nor of my cattle, nor of mine! Yonder lunar mansions glide away and glide upward with the vital breaths of all beings. Do not glide away, do not glide upward with the vital breaths of my offspring, nor of my cattle, nor of mine!

1.14.s: mā me prajāyā mā paśūnām | mā mama prāṇairāpūriṣṭhāḥ | asau yo'pakṣīyati | sa sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ prāṇairapakṣīyati | mā me prajāyā mā paśūnām | mā mama prāṇairapakṣeṣṭhāḥ | amūni nakṣatrāṇi | sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ prāṇairapaprasarpanti cothsarpanti ca | mā me prajāyā mā paśūnām | mā mama prāṇairapaprasṛpata mothsṛpata
1.14.d: मा मे प्रजाया मा पशूनाम् । मा मम प्राणैरापूरिष्ठाः । असौ योऽपक्षीयति । स सर्वेषां भूतानां प्राणैरपक्षीयति । मा मे प्रजाया मा पशूनाम् । मा मम प्राणैरपक्षेष्ठाः । अमूनि नक्षत्राणि । सर्वेषां भूतानां प्राणैरपप्रसर्पन्ति चोथ्सर्पन्ति च । मा मे प्रजाया मा पशूनाम् । मा मम प्राणैरपप्रसृपत मोथ्सृपत

1.14.s: ime māsāścārdhamāsāśca | sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ prāṇairapaprasarpanti cothsarpanti ca | mā me prajāyā mā paśūnām | mā mama prāṇairapaprasṛpata mothsṛpata | ima ṛtavaḥ | sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ prāṇairapaprasarpanti cothsarpanti ca | mā me prajāyā mā paśūnām | mā mama prāṇairapaprasṛpata mothsṛpata | ayaṃ saṃvathsaraḥ | sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ prāṇairapaprasarpati cothsarpati ca
1.14.d: इमे मासाश्चार्धमासाश्च । सर्वेषां भूतानां प्राणैरपप्रसर्पन्ति चोथ्सर्पन्ति च । मा मे प्रजाया मा पशूनाम् । मा मम प्राणैरपप्रसृपत मोथ्सृपत । इम ऋतवः । सर्वेषां भूतानां प्राणैरपप्रसर्पन्ति चोथ्सर्पन्ति च । मा मे प्रजाया मा पशूनाम् । मा मम प्राणैरपप्रसृपत मोथ्सृपत । अयं संवथ्सरः । सर्वेषां भूतानां प्राणैरपप्रसर्पति चोथ्सर्पति च
1.14.m:
These months and half-months glide away and glide upward with the vital breaths of all beings. Do not glide away, do not glide upward with the vital breaths of my offspring, nor of my cattle, nor of mine! These seasons glide away and glide upward with the vital breaths of all beings. Do not glide away, do not glide upward with the vital breaths of my offspring, nor of my cattle, nor of mine! This year glides away and glides upward with the vital breaths of all beings.

Do not glide away, do not glide upward with the vital breaths of my offspring, nor of my cattle, nor of mine! This day glides away and glides upward with the vital breaths of all beings. Do not glide away, do not glide upward with the vital breaths of my offspring, nor of my cattle, nor of mine! This night glides away and glides upward with the vital breaths of all beings. Do not glide away, do not glide upward with the vital breaths of my offspring, nor of my cattle, nor of mine! Om, bhūr, bhuvaḥ, svaḥ! This is your pairing; do not consume our pair! / [Index: prāṇairāpūryati mothsṛpata cothsarpati ca mothsṛpa dve ca]

1.14.s: mā me prajāyā mā paśūnām | mā mama prāṇairapaprasṛpa mothsṛpa | idamahaḥ | sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ prāṇairapaprasarpati cothsarpati ca | mā me prajāyā mā paśūnām | mā mama prāṇairapaprasṛpa mothsṛpa | iyaṃrātriḥ | sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ prāṇairapaprasarpati cothsarpati ca | mā me prajāyā mā paśūnām | mā mama prāṇairapaprasṛpa mothsṛpa | oṃ bhūrbhuvassvaḥ | etadvo mithunaṃ māno mithunaṃ rīḍhvam
1.14.d: मा मे प्रजाया मा पशूनाम् । मा मम प्राणैरपप्रसृप मोथ्सृप । इदमहः । सर्वेषां भूतानां प्राणैरपप्रसर्पति चोथ्सर्पति च । मा मे प्रजाया मा पशूनाम् । मा मम प्राणैरपप्रसृप मोथ्सृप । इयंरात्रिः । सर्वेषां भूतानां प्राणैरपप्रसर्पति चोथ्सर्पति च । मा मे प्रजाया मा पशूनाम् । मा मम प्राणैरपप्रसृप मोथ्सृप । ओं भूर्भुवस्स्वः । एतद्वो मिथुनं मानो मिथुनं रीढ्वम्

1.15.s: athādityasyāṣṭapuruṣasya | vasūnāmādityānāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | rudrāṇāmādityānāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | ādityānāmādityānāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | satāṃsatyānām | ādityānāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | abhidhūnvatāmabhighnatām | vātavatāṃ marutām | ādityānāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | ṛbhūṇāmādityānāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | viśveṣāndevānām | ādityānāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | saṃvathsarasya savituḥ | ādityasya sthāne svatejasā bhāni | oṃ bhūrbhuvassvaḥ | raśmayo vo mithunaṃ mā no mithunaṃ rīḍhvam
1.15.d: अथादित्यस्याष्टपुरुषस्य । वसूनामादित्यानाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । रुद्राणामादित्यानाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । आदित्यानामादित्यानाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । सतांसत्यानाम् । आदित्यानाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । अभिधून्वतामभिघ्नताम् । वातवतां मरुताम् । आदित्यानाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । ऋभूणामादित्यानाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । विश्वेषान्देवानाम् । आदित्यानाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । संवथ्सरस्य सवितुः । आदित्यस्य स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । ओं भूर्भुवस्स्वः । रश्मयो वो मिथुनं मा नो मिथुनं रीढ्वम्
1.15.m: Now of the Āditya of eight persons: In the abode of the Vasu-Ādityas, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the Rudra-Ādityas, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the Āditya-Ādityas, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the true Sat-Ādityas, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the shaking, striking, windy Marut-Ādityas, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the Ṛbhu-Ādityas, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the Viśve Devas-Ādityas, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the Year, Savitṛ, the Āditya, may I shine with my own splendor! Om, bhūr, bhuvaḥ, svaḥ! Rays are your pairing; do not consume our pair! / [Index: ṛbhūṇāmādityānāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni ṣaṭ ca]

1.16.s: ārogasya sthāne svatejasā bhāni | bhrājasya sthāne svatejasā bhāni | paṭarasya sthāne svatejasā bhāni | pataṅgasya sthāne svatejasā bhāni | svarṇarasya sthāne svatejasā bhāni | jyotiṣīmatasya sthāne svatejasā bhāni | vibhāsasya sthāne svatejasā bhāni | kaśyapasya sthāne svatejasā bhāni | oṃ bhūrbhuvassvaḥ | āpo vo mithunaṃ mā no mithunaṃ rīḍhvam
1.16.d: आरोगस्य स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । भ्राजस्य स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । पटरस्य स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । पतङ्गस्य स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । स्वर्णरस्य स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । ज्योतिषीमतस्य स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । विभासस्य स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । कश्यपस्य स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । ओं भूर्भुवस्स्वः । आपो वो मिथुनं मा नो मिथुनं रीढ्वम्
1.16.m: In the abode of Āroga, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of Bhrāja, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of Paṭara, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of Pataṅga, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of Svarṇara, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of Jyotiṣīmant, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of Vibhāsa, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of Kaśyapa, may I shine with my own splendor! Om, bhūr, bhuvaḥ, svaḥ! Waters are your pairing; do not consume our pair! / [Index: ārogasya daśa]

1.17.s: atha vāyorekādaśapuruṣasyaikādaśastrīkasya | prabhrājamānānāṃ rudrāṇāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | vyavadātānāṃ rudrāṇāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | vāsukivaidyutānāṃ rudrāṇāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | rajatānāṃ rudrāṇāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | paruṣāṇāṃ rudrāṇāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | śyāmānāṃ rudrāṇāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | kapilānāṃ rudrāṇāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | atilohitānāṃ rudrāṇāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | ūrdhvānāṃ rudrāṇāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni
1.17.d: अथ वायोरेकादशपुरुषस्यैकादशस्त्रीकस्य । प्रभ्राजमानानां रुद्राणाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । व्यवदातानां रुद्राणाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । वासुकिवैद्युतानां रुद्राणाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । रजतानां रुद्राणाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । परुषाणां रुद्राणाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । श्यामानां रुद्राणाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । कपिलानां रुद्राणाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । अतिलोहितानां रुद्राणाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । ऊर्ध्वानां रुद्राणाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि
1.17.m: Now of Vāyu having eleven persons and eleven wives: In the abode of the blazing Rudras, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the purely white Rudras, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the Vāsuki-lightning Rudras, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the silvery Rudras, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the variegated Rudras, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the dark Rudras, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the tawny Rudras, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the deep-red Rudras, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the upward-tending Rudras, may I shine with my own splendor!

1.17.s: avapatantānāṃ rudrāṇāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | vaidyutānāṃ rudrāṇāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | prabhrājamānīnāṃ rudrāṇīnāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | vyavadātīnāṃ rudrāṇīnāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | vāsukivaidyutīnāṃ rudrāṇīnāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | rajatānāṃ rudrāṇīnāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | paruṣāṇāṃ rudrāṇīnāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | śyāmānāṃ rudrāṇīnāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | kapilānāṃ rudrāṇīnāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | atilohitīnāṃ rudrāṇīnāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | ūrdhvānāṃ rudrāṇīnāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | avapatantīnāṃ rudrāṇīnāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | vaidyutīnāṃ rudrāṇīnāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni | oṃ bhūrbhuvassvaḥ | rūpāṇi vo mithunaṃ mā no mithunaṃ rīḍhvam
1.17.d: अवपतन्तानां रुद्राणाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । वैद्युतानां रुद्राणाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । प्रभ्राजमानीनां रुद्राणीनाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । व्यवदातीनां रुद्राणीनाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । वासुकिवैद्युतीनां रुद्राणीनाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । रजतानां रुद्राणीनाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । परुषाणां रुद्राणीनाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । श्यामानां रुद्राणीनाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । कपिलानां रुद्राणीनाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । अतिलोहितीनां रुद्राणीनाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । ऊर्ध्वानां रुद्राणीनाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । अवपतन्तीनां रुद्राणीनाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । वैद्युतीनां रुद्राणीनाग् स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । ओं भूर्भुवस्स्वः । रूपाणि वो मिथुनं मा नो मिथुनं रीढ्वम्
1.17.m: In the abode of the downward-falling Rudras, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the lightning Rudras, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the blazing Rudrāṇīs, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the purely white Rudrāṇīs, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the Vāsuki-lightning Rudrāṇīs, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the silvery Rudrāṇīs, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the variegated Rudrāṇīs, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the dark Rudrāṇīs, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the tawny Rudrāṇīs, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the deep-red Rudrāṇīs, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the upward-tending Rudrāṇīs, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the downward-falling Rudrāṇīs, may I shine with my own splendor! In the abode of the lightning Rudrāṇīs, may I shine with my own splendor! Om, bhūr, bhuvaḥ, svaḥ! Forms are your pairing; do not consume our pair! / [Index: ūrdhvānāṃ rudrāṇāg sthāne svatejasā bhānyatilohitīnāṃ rudrāṇīnāg sthāne svatejasā bhāni pañca ca]

1.18.s: athāgneraṣṭapuruṣasya | agneḥ pūrvadiśyasya sthāne svatejasā bhāni | jātavedasa upadiśyasya sthāne svatejasā bhāni | sahojaso dakṣiṇadiśyasya sthāne svatejasā bhāni | ajirāprabhava upadiśyasya sthāne svatejasā bhāni | vaiśvānarasyāparadiśyasya sthāne svatejasā bhāni | naryāpasa upadiśyasya sthāne svatejasā bhāni | paṅktirādhasa udagdiśyasya sthāne svatejasā bhāni | visarpiṇa upadiśyasya sthāne svatejasā bhāni | oṃ bhūrbhuvassvaḥ | diśo vo mithunaṃ mā no mithunaṃ rīḍhvam
1.18.d: अथाग्नेरष्टपुरुषस्य । अग्नेः पूर्वदिश्यस्य स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । जातवेदस उपदिश्यस्य स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । सहोजसो दक्षिणदिश्यस्य स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । अजिराप्रभव उपदिश्यस्य स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । वैश्वानरस्यापरदिश्यस्य स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । नर्यापस उपदिश्यस्य स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । पङ्क्तिराधस उदग्दिश्यस्य स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । विसर्पिण उपदिश्यस्य स्थाने स्वतेजसा भानि । ओं भूर्भुवस्स्वः । दिशो वो मिथुनं मा नो मिथुनं रीढ्वम्
1.18.m: Now of Agni of eight persons: In the place of Agni belonging to the eastern quarter, may I shine with my own brilliance. In the place of Jātavedas belonging to the intermediate quarter, may I shine with my own brilliance. In the place of Sahojas belonging to the southern quarter, may I shine with my own brilliance. In the place of Ajirāprabhava belonging to the intermediate quarter, may I shine with my own brilliance. In the place of Vaiśvānara belonging to the western quarter, may I shine with my own brilliance. In the place of Naryāpas belonging to the intermediate quarter, may I shine with my own brilliance. In the place of Paṅktirādhas belonging to the northern quarter, may I shine with my own brilliance. In the place of Visarpin belonging to the intermediate quarter, may I shine with my own brilliance. Om, bhūr, bhuvaḥ, svaḥ. The quarters are your pair; do not lick our pair! / Heaven and one || 18 || These rays, the waters, the forms, the quarters, five.

1.19.s: dakṣiṇapūrvasyāndiśi visarpī narakaḥ | tasmānnaḥ paripāhi | dakṣiṇā'parasyāndiśyavisarpī narakaḥ | tasmānnaḥ paripāhi | uttarapūrvasyāndiśi viṣādī narakaḥ | tasmānnaḥ paripāhi | uttarāparasyāndiśyaviṣādī narakaḥ | tasmānnaḥ paripāhi | āyasminthsapta vāsavā indriyāṇi śatakratavityete
1.19.d: दक्षिणपूर्वस्यान्दिशि विसर्पी नरकः । तस्मान्नः परिपाहि । दक्षिणाऽपरस्यान्दिश्यविसर्पी नरकः । तस्मान्नः परिपाहि । उत्तरपूर्वस्यान्दिशि विषादी नरकः । तस्मान्नः परिपाहि । उत्तरापरस्यान्दिश्यविषादी नरकः । तस्मान्नः परिपाहि । आयस्मिन्थ्सप्त वासवा इन्द्रियाणि शतक्रतवित्येते
1.19.m: In the south-eastern quarter is the hell Visarpin; protect us from it. / In the south-western quarter is the hell Avisarpin; protect us from it. In the north-eastern quarter is the hell Viṣādin; protect us from it. In the north-western quarter is the hell Aviṣādin; / protect us from it. “In which seven”, “the Vasus”, “the senses”, “O Śatakratu”—these / in the south-east, nine.

1.20.s: indraghoṣā vo vasubhiḥ purastādupadadhatām | manojavaso vaḥ pitṛbhirdakṣiṇata upadadhatām | pracetā vo rudraiḥ paścādupadadhatām | viśvakarmā va ādityairuttarata upadadhatām | tvaṣṭā vo rūpairupariṣṭādupadadhatām | saṃjñānaṃ vaḥ paścāditi | ādityassarvo'gniḥ pṛthivyām | vāyurantarikṣe | sūryo divi | candramā dikṣu | nakṣatrāṇi svaloke | evā hyeva | evā hyagne | evā hi vāyo | evā hīndra | evā hi pūṣan | evā hi devāḥ
1.20.d: इन्द्रघोषा वो वसुभिः पुरस्तादुपदधताम् । मनोजवसो वः पितृभिर्दक्षिणत उपदधताम् । प्रचेता वो रुद्रैः पश्चादुपदधताम् । विश्वकर्मा व आदित्यैरुत्तरत उपदधताम् । त्वष्टा वो रूपैरुपरिष्टादुपदधताम् । संज्ञानं वः पश्चादिति । आदित्यस्सर्वोऽग्निः पृथिव्याम् । वायुरन्तरिक्षे । सूर्यो दिवि । चन्द्रमा दिक्षु । नक्षत्राणि स्वलोके । एवा ह्येव । एवा ह्यग्ने । एवा हि वायो । एवा हीन्द्र । एवा हि पूषन् । एवा हि देवाः
1.20.m: May the Indraghoṣas place you from the east with the Vasus. May the Manojavases place you from the south with the fathers. May Pracetas place you from the west with the Rudras. May Viśvakarman place you from the north with the Ādityas. / May Tvaṣṭṛ place you from above with the forms. “Harmonious consciousness behind you.” / Āditya is all. Agni is on earth; Vāyu in the intermediate space; Sūrya in the sky; the moon in the quarters; the asterisms in their own world. Truly so, truly. Truly so, O Agni. Truly so, O Vāyu. Truly so, O Indra. Truly so, O Pūṣan. Truly so, O gods. / In the quarters, and seven.

1.21.s: āpamāpāmapaḥ sarvāḥ | asmādasmādito'mutaḥ | agnirvāyuśca sūryaśca | saha sañcaskararddhiyā | vāyvaśvā raśmipatayaḥ | marīcyātmāno adruhaḥ | devīrbhuvanasūvarīḥ | putravattvāya me suta | mahānāmnīrmahāmānāḥ | mahaso mahasassvaḥ
1.21.d: आपमापामपः सर्वाः । अस्मादस्मादितोऽमुतः । अग्निर्वायुश्च सूर्यश्च । सह सञ्चस्करर्द्धिया । वाय्वश्वा रश्मिपतयः । मरीच्यात्मानो अद्रुहः । देवीर्भुवनसूवरीः । पुत्रवत्त्वाय मे सुत । महानाम्नीर्महामानाः । महसो महसस्स्वः
1.21.m: I have reached the waters, all the waters, / from here, from there, from yonder. / Agni, Vāyu, and Sūrya / have gathered them together with prosperity. / Having the wind for horses, lords of rays, / having their self in beams of light, free from malice, / divine, bearing the worlds, / bring forth for me the possession of sons! / You of great name, of great measure, / heaven from greatness to greatness!

1.21.s: devīḥ parjanyasūvarīḥ | putravattvāya me suta | apā'śnyuṣṇimapārakṣaḥ | apā'śnyuṣṇimapāragham | apāghrāmapacā'vartim | apadevīrito hita | vajrandevīrajītāṃśca | bhuvanandevasūvarīḥ | ādityānaditindevīm | yoninordhvamudīṣata
1.21.d: देवीः पर्जन्यसूवरीः । पुत्रवत्त्वाय मे सुत । अपाऽश्न्युष्णिमपारक्षः । अपाऽश्न्युष्णिमपारघम् । अपाघ्रामपचाऽवर्तिम् । अपदेवीरितो हित । वज्रन्देवीरजीतांश्च । भुवनन्देवसूवरीः । आदित्यानदितिन्देवीम् । योनिनोर्ध्वमुदीषत
1.21.m: Divine, bearing Parjanya, / bring forth for me the possession of sons! / [Drive] away the hunger and heat, drive away the rakṣas! / Drive away the hunger and heat, drive away evil! / Drive away the stench, drive away distress! / Drive away the goddesses from here! / Divine thunderbolt and unvanquished ones, / bearing the world and the gods, / the Ādityas, the divine Aditi— / through the womb they have ascended upward.

1.21.s: bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devāḥ | bhadraṃ paśyemākṣabhiryajatrāḥ | sthirairaṅgaistuṣṭuvāṃsastanūbhiḥ | vyaśema devahitaṃ yadāyuḥ | svasti na indro vṛddhaśravāḥ | svasti naḥ pūṣā viśvavedāḥ | svastinastārkṣyo ariṣṭanemiḥ | svasti no bṛhaspatirdadhātu | ketavo aruṇāsaśca | ṛṣayo vātaraśanāḥ | pratiṣṭhāṃ śatadhā hi | samāhitāso sahasradhāyasam | śivā naḥ śantamā bhavantu | divyā āpa oṣadhayaḥ | sumṛḍīkā sarasvati | mā te vyoma saṃdṛśi
1.21.d: भद्रं कर्णेभिः शृणुयाम देवाः । भद्रं पश्येमाक्षभिर्यजत्राः । स्थिरैरङ्गैस्तुष्टुवांसस्तनूभिः । व्यशेम देवहितं यदायुः । स्वस्ति न इन्द्रो वृद्धश्रवाः । स्वस्ति नः पूषा विश्ववेदाः । स्वस्तिनस्तार्क्ष्यो अरिष्टनेमिः । स्वस्ति नो बृहस्पतिर्दधातु । केतवो अरुणासश्च । ऋषयो वातरशनाः । प्रतिष्ठां शतधा हि । समाहितासो सहस्रधायसम् । शिवा नः शन्तमा भवन्तु । दिव्या आप ओषधयः । सुमृडीका सरस्वति । मा ते व्योम संदृशि
1.21.m: May we hear what is auspicious with our ears, O gods; / may we see what is auspicious with our eyes, O holy ones! / Praising with firm limbs and bodies, / may we attain the lifespan ordained by the gods! / May Indra of ancient renown grant us well-being; / may Pūṣan the all-knowing grant us well-being! / May Tārkṣya of unimpaired rim grant us well-being; / may Bṛhaspati ordain well-being for us! / And the Ketus, the red ones, / the wind-girt seers; / for a foundation in a hundred ways, / collected together, sustaining a thousandfold. / May they be auspicious, most comforting to us: / the heavenly waters, the plants! / O most merciful Sarasvatī, / may we not find your space [closed] to sight! / Heaven, have ascended, wind-girt, and six.

1.22.s: yo'pāṃ puṣpaṃ veda | puṣpavānprajāvānpaśumānbhavati | candramā vā apāṃ puṣpam | puṣpavānprajāvānpaśumānbhavati | ya evaṃ veda | yo'pāmāyatanaṃ veda | āyatanavānbhavati | agnirvā apāmāyatanam | āyatanavānbhavati | yo'gnerāyatanaṃ veda
1.22.d: योऽपां पुष्पं वेद । पुष्पवान्प्रजावान्पशुमान्भवति । चन्द्रमा वा अपां पुष्पम् । पुष्पवान्प्रजावान्पशुमान्भवति । य एवं वेद । योऽपामायतनं वेद । आयतनवान्भवति । अग्निर्वा अपामायतनम् । आयतनवान्भवति । योऽग्नेरायतनं वेद
1.22.m:
