4.3.s: mitrasya carṣaṇīdhṛtaḥ | śravo devasya sānasim | dyumnaṃ citraśravastamam | siddhyai tvā | devastvā savitodvapatu | supāṇissvaṅguriḥ | subāhuruta śaktyā | apadyamānaḥ pṛthivyām | āśā diśa āpṛṇa | uttiṣṭha bṛhanbhava
4.3.d: मित्रस्य चर्षणीधृतः । श्रवो देवस्य सानसिम् । द्युम्नं चित्रश्रवस्तमम् । सिद्ध्यै त्वा । देवस्त्वा सवितोद्वपतु । सुपाणिस्स्वङ्गुरिः । सुबाहुरुत शक्त्या । अपद्यमानः पृथिव्याम् । आशा दिश आपृण । उत्तिष्ठ बृहन्भव
4.3.m: The fame of Mitra, upholder of men / the divine, won of old / brilliant, most richly renowned / Thee for success / May the god Savitṛ dig thee out / fair of hands, fair of fingers / fair of arms, and with his might / Not falling down upon the earth / fill the quarters and intermediate directions / Stand up, become great

4.3.s: ūrdhvastiṣṭha dhruvastvam | sūryasya tvā cakṣuṣā'nvīkṣe | ṛjave tvā | sādhave tvā | sukṣityai tvā bhūtyai tvā | idamahamamumāmuṣyāyaṇaṃ viśā paśubhirbrahmavarcasena paryūhāmi | gāyatreṇa tvā chandasā''cchṛṇadmi | traiṣṭubhena tvā chandasā''cchṛṇadmi | jāgatena tvā chandasā''cchṛṇadmi | chṛṇattu tvā vāk | chṛṇattu tvork | chṛṇattu tvā haviḥ | chṛndhi vācam | chṛndhyūrjam | chṛndhi haviḥ | deva puraścara saghyāsaṃ tvā
4.3.d: ऊर्ध्वस्तिष्ठ ध्रुवस्त्वम् । सूर्यस्य त्वा चक्षुषाऽन्वीक्षे । ऋजवे त्वा । साधवे त्वा । सुक्षित्यै त्वा भूत्यै त्वा । इदमहममुमामुष्यायणं विशा पशुभिर्ब्रह्मवर्चसेन पर्यूहामि । गायत्रेण त्वा छन्दसा'ऽच्छृणद्मि । त्रैष्टुभेन त्वा छन्दसा'ऽच्छृणद्मि । जागतेन त्वा छन्दसा'ऽच्छृणद्मि । छृणत्तु त्वा वाक् । छृणत्तु त्वोर्क् । छृणत्तु त्वा हविः । छृन्धि वाचम् । छृन्ध्यूर्जम् । छृन्धि हविः । देव पुरश्चर सघ्यासं त्वा
4.3.m:
Stand upright, firm art thou / I gaze upon thee with Sūrya's eye / Thee for the straight / Thee for the good / Thee for secure dwelling, thee for prosperity / Here do I surround this one, son of such-a-one, with the people, with cattle, with the splendour of brahman / With the gāyatrī metre I pierce thee / With the triṣṭubh metre I pierce thee / With the jagatī metre I pierce thee / May speech pierce thee / May vigour pierce thee / May the oblation pierce thee / Pierce speech / Pierce vigour / Pierce the oblation / O god, going in front, may I be able to bear thee
Earth, become, speech, and six.

4.4.s: brahmanpravargyeṇa pracariṣyāmaḥ | hotargharmamabhiṣṭuhi | agnīdrauhiṇau puroḍāśāvadhiśraya | pratiprasthātarvihara | prastotassāmāni gāya | yajuryuktaṃ sāmabhirāktakhaṃ tvā | viśvairdevairanumataṃ marudbhiḥ | dakṣiṇābhiḥ pratataṃ pārayiṣṇum | stubho vahantu sumanasyamānam | sa no rucaṃ dhehyahṛṇīyamānaḥ | bhūrbhuvassuvaḥ | omindravantaḥ pracarata
4.4.d: ब्रह्मन्प्रवर्ग्येण प्रचरिष्यामः । होतर्घर्ममभिष्टुहि । अग्नीद्रौहिणौ पुरोडाशावधिश्रय । प्रतिप्रस्थातर्विहर । प्रस्तोतस्सामानि गाय । यजुर्युक्तं सामभिराक्तखं त्वा । विश्वैर्देवैरनुमतं मरुद्भिः । दक्षिणाभिः प्रततं पारयिष्णुम् । स्तुभो वहन्तु सुमनस्यमानम् । स नो रुचं धेह्यहृणीयमानः । भूर्भुवस्सुवः । ओमिन्द्रवन्तः प्रचरत
4.4.m:
O brahman, we shall proceed with the pravargya / O hotṛ, praise the gharma / O agnīdh, set the two rauhiṇa sacrificial cakes on the fire / O pratiprasthātṛ, distribute [the fires] / O prastotṛ, sing the sāmans / Thee, yoked with the Yajus, anointed with sāmans across the cavity / assented to by all the gods, by the Maruts / extended with priestly fees, capable of saving / may the praises carry thee, as thou art well-disposed / Do thou, without resentment, grant us radiance / Bhūr, bhuvaḥ, suvaḥ / Oṃ, proceed, accompanied by Indra
Without resentment, and two.

4.5.s: brahmanpracariṣyāmaḥ | hotargharmamabhiṣṭuhi | yamāya tvā makhāya tvā | sūryasya harase tvā | prāṇāya svāhā vyānāya svāhā'pānāya svāhā | cakṣuṣe svāhā śrotrāya svāhā | manase svāhā vāce sarasvatyai svāhā | dakṣāya svāhā kratave svāhā | ojase svāhā balāya svāhā | devastvā savitā madhvā'naktu
4.5.d: ब्रह्मन्प्रचरिष्यामः । होतर्घर्ममभिष्टुहि । यमाय त्वा मखाय त्वा । सूर्यस्य हरसे त्वा । प्राणाय स्वाहा व्यानाय स्वाहाऽपानाय स्वाहा । चक्षुषे स्वाहा श्रोत्राय स्वाहा । मनसे स्वाहा वाचे सरस्वत्यै स्वाहा । दक्षाय स्वाहा क्रतवे स्वाहा । ओजसे स्वाहा बलाय स्वाहा । देवस्त्वा सविता मध्वाऽनक्तु
4.5.m: "O brahman priest, we shall proceed. O hotṛ priest, recite in praise of the gharma." / To Yama, to Makha! To the glowing heat of Sūrya! / To prāṇa svāhā! To vyāna svāhā! To apāna svāhā! / To the eye svāhā! To the ear svāhā! / To the mind svāhā! To speech, to Sarasvatī svāhā! / To ability svāhā! To intention svāhā! / To power svāhā! To strength svāhā! / May the god Savitṛ anoint you with sweetness!

4.5.s: pṛthivīṃ tapasastrāyasva | arcirasi śocirasi jyotirasi taposi | saṃ sīdasva mahāṃ asi | śocasva devavītamaḥ | vidhūmamagne aruṣaṃ miyedhya | sṛja praśasta darśatam | añjanti yaṃ prathayanto na viprāḥ | vapāvantaṃ nāgninā tapantaḥ | piturna putra upasi preṣṭhaḥ | ā gharmo agnimṛtayannasādīt
4.5.d: पृथिवीं तपसस्त्रायस्व । अर्चिरसि शोचिरसि ज्योतिरसि तपोसि । सं सीदस्व महां असि । शोचस्व देववीतमः । विधूममग्ने अरुषं मियेध्य । सृज प्रशस्त दर्शतम् । अञ्जन्ति यं प्रथयन्तो न विप्राः । वपावन्तं नाग्निना तपन्तः । पितुर्न पुत्र उपसि प्रेष्ठः । आ घर्मो अग्निमृतयन्नसादीत्
4.5.m: Protect the earth from ascetic heat! / You are the flame, you are the blaze, you are the light, you are the heat. / Sit down, you are great; shine brightly, most eager for the gods. / O Agni worthy of the sacrificial feast, release the smoke-free, radiant [steam], splendid, lovely to behold. / Whom wise men anoint as if stretching [a cloth], heating with fire like a fatty [offering]— / dearest, like a son in his father's lap, the gharma has sat down, making for the fire [its] path of order.

4.5.s: anādhṛṣyā purastāt | agnerādhipatye | āyurme dāḥ | putravatī dakṣiṇataḥ | indrasyādhipatye | prajāṃ me dāḥ | suṣadā paścāt | devasya saviturādhipatye | prāṇaṃ me dāḥ | āśrutiruttarataḥ
4.5.d: अनाधृष्या पुरस्तात् । अग्नेराधिपत्ये । आयुर्मे दाः । पुत्रवती दक्षिणतः । इन्द्रस्याधिपत्ये । प्रजां मे दाः । सुषदा पश्चात् । देवस्य सवितुराधिपत्ये । प्राणं मे दाः । आश्रुतिरुत्तरतः
4.5.m: Unassailable in the east, under the overlordship of Agni; grant me lifespan! / Possessed of sons in the south, under the overlordship of Indra; grant me offspring! / Easy to sit upon in the west, under the overlordship of the god Savitṛ; grant me vital breath! / Renowned in the north,

4.5.s: mitrāvaruṇayorādhipatye | śrotraṃ me dāḥ | vidhṛtirupariṣṭāt | bṛhaspaterādhipatye | brahma me dāḥ kṣattraṃ me dāḥ | tejo me dhā varco me dhāḥ | yaśo me dhāstapo me dhāḥ | mano me dhāḥ | manoraśvā'si bhūriputrā | viśvābhyo mā nāṣṭrābhyaḥ pāhi
4.5.d: मित्रावरुणयोराधिपत्ये । श्रोत्रं मे दाः । विधृतिरुपरिष्टात् । बृहस्पतेराधिपत्ये । ब्रह्म मे दाः क्षत्त्रं मे दाः । तेजो मे धा वर्चो मे धाः । यशो मे धास्तपो मे धाः । मनो मे धाः । मनोरश्वाऽसि भूरिपुत्रा । विश्वाभ्यो मा नाष्ट्राभ्यः पाहि
4.5.m: under the overlordship of Mitra and Varuṇa; grant me hearing! / Support from above, under the overlordship of Bṛhaspati; grant me brahman, grant me temporal power! / Bestow brilliance upon me, bestow spiritual lustre upon me! / Bestow fame upon me, bestow ascetic heat upon me! Bestow mind upon me! / You are Manu's mare, mother of many sons; / protect me from all destructions!

4.5.s: sūpasadā me bhūyā mā mā hiṃsīḥ | tapo ṣvagne antarāṃ amitrān | tapā śaṃsamararuṣaḥ parasya | tapā vaso cikitāno acittān | vi te tiṣṭhantāmajarā ayāsaḥ | citasstha paricitaḥ | svāhā marudbhiḥ pariśrayasva | mā asi | pramā asi | pratimā asi
4.5.d: सूपसदा मे भूया मा मा हिंसीः । तपो ष्वग्ने अन्तरां अमित्रान् । तपा शंसमररुषः परस्य । तपा वसो चिकितानो अचित्तान् । वि ते तिष्ठन्तामजरा अयासः । चितस्स्थ परिचितः । स्वाहा मरुद्भिः परिश्रयस्व । मा असि । प्रमा असि । प्रतिमा असि
4.5.m: Be easy of approach to me; do not harm me! / Burn well, O Agni, the enemies within; / burn the curse of the hostile outsider; / burn, O Vasu, knowing, the ignorant ones! / May your ageless, untiring [flames] spread apart! / You are piled; you are enclosed. Svāhā! / Enclose yourself with the Maruts! / You are the measure; you are the fore-measure; you are the counter-measure;

4.5.s: saṃmā asi | vimā asi | unmā asi | antarikṣasyāntardhirasi | divaṃ tapasastrāyasva | ābhirgīrbhiryadato na ūnam | āpyāyaya harivo vardhamānaḥ | yadā stotṛbhyo mahi gotrā rujāsi | bhūyiṣṭhabhājo adha te syāma | śukraṃ te anyadyajataṃ te anyat
4.5.d: संमा असि । विमा असि । उन्मा असि । अन्तरिक्षस्यान्तर्धिरसि । दिवं तपसस्त्रायस्व । आभिर्गीर्भिर्यदतो न ऊनम् । आप्यायय हरिवो वर्धमानः । यदा स्तोतृभ्यो महि गोत्रा रुजासि । भूयिष्ठभाजो अध ते स्याम । शुक्रं ते अन्यद्यजतं ते अन्यत्
4.5.m: you are the gathering measure; you are the wide measure; you are the up-measure. / You are the concealment of the intermediate space; protect the sky from ascetic heat! / With these songs, that which of ours is deficient, / make swell, O lord of bay horses, waxing great! / When for the praisers you break open the great cow-pens, / then may we be the ones with the largest share! / One is your bright form, another is your sacrificial form;

4.5.s: viṣurūpe ahanī dyaurivāsi | viśvā hi māyā avasi svadhāvaḥ | bhadrā te pūṣanniha rātirastu | arhanbibharṣi sāyakāni dhanva | arhanniṣkaṃ yajataṃ viśvarūpam | arhannidaṃ dayase viśvamabbhuvam | na vā ojīyo rudra tvadasti | gāyatramasi | traiṣṭubhamasi | jāgatamasi | madhu madhu madhu
4.5.d: विषुरूपे अहनी द्यौरिवासि । विश्वा हि माया अवसि स्वधावः । भद्रा ते पूषन्निह रातिरस्तु । अर्हन्बिभर्षि सायकानि धन्व । अर्हन्निष्कं यजतं विश्वरूपम् । अर्हन्निदं दयसे विश्वमब्भुवम् । न वा ओजीयो रुद्र त्वदस्ति । गायत्रमसि । त्रैष्टुभमसि । जागतमसि । मधु मधु मधु
4.5.m: having diverse forms, you are like heaven with day [and night]. / For you protect all wondrous powers, O self-ruling one! / May your bounty here be auspicious, O Pūṣan! / Worthily you bear the arrows and bow; / worthily [you wear] the golden necklace, sacrificial, of all forms; / worthily you distribute all this wide world; / for there is nothing more powerful than you, O Rudra! / You are the gāyatrī; you are the triṣṭubh; you are the jagatī. / Honey, honey, honey!

4.6.s: daśa prācīrdaśa bhāsi dakṣiṇā | daśa pratīcīrdaśa bhāsyudīcīḥ | daśordhvā bhāsi sumanasyamānaḥ | sa no rucaṃ dhehyahṛṇīyamānaḥ | agniṣṭvā vasubhiḥ purastādrocayatu gāyatreṇa chandasā | sa mā rucito rocaya | indrastvā rudrairdakṣiṇato rocayatu traiṣṭubhena chandasā | sa mā rucito rocaya | varuṇastvādityaiḥ paścādrocayatu jāgatena chandasā | sa mā rucito rocaya
4.6.d: दश प्राचीर्दश भासि दक्षिणा । दश प्रतीचीर्दश भास्युदीचीः । दशोर्ध्वा भासि सुमनस्यमानः । स नो रुचं धेह्यहृणीयमानः । अग्निष्ट्वा वसुभिः पुरस्ताद्रोचयतु गायत्रेण छन्दसा । स मा रुचितो रोचय । इन्द्रस्त्वा रुद्रैर्दक्षिणतो रोचयतु त्रैष्टुभेन छन्दसा । स मा रुचितो रोचय । वरुणस्त्वादित्यैः पश्चाद्रोचयतु जागतेन छन्दसा । स मा रुचितो रोचय
4.6.m: Ten [rays] eastwards, ten you shine southwards; / ten westwards, ten you shine northwards; / ten upwards you shine, being gracious; / as such, grant us splendour, not bearing wrath! / May Agni with the Vasus make you shine from the east with the gāyatrī metre! Shining, make me shine! / May Indra with the Rudras make you shine from the south with the triṣṭubh metre! Shining, make me shine! / May Varuṇa with the Ādityas make you shine from the west with the jagatī metre! Shining, make me shine!

4.6.s: dyutānastvā māruto marudbhiruttarato rocayatvānuṣṭubhena chandasā | sa mā rucito rocaya | bṛhaspatistvā viśvairdevairupariṣṭādrocayatu pāṅktena chandasā | sa mā rucito rocaya | rocitastvaṃ deva gharma deveṣvasi | rociṣīyāhaṃ manuṣyeṣu | samrāḍgharma rucitastvaṃ deveṣvāyuṣmāṃstejasvī brahmavarcasyasi | rucito'haṃ manuṣyeṣvāyuṣmāṃstejasvī brahmavarcasī bhūyāsam | rugasi | rucaṃ mayi dhehi
4.6.d: द्युतानस्त्वा मारुतो मरुद्भिरुत्तरतो रोचयत्वानुष्टुभेन छन्दसा । स मा रुचितो रोचय । बृहस्पतिस्त्वा विश्वैर्देवैरुपरिष्टाद्रोचयतु पाङ्क्तेन छन्दसा । स मा रुचितो रोचय । रोचितस्त्वं देव घर्म देवेष्वसि । रोचिषीयाहं मनुष्येषु । सम्राड्घर्म रुचितस्त्वं देवेष्वायुष्मांस्तेजस्वी ब्रह्मवर्चस्यसि । रुचितोऽहं मनुष्येष्वायुष्मांस्तेजस्वी ब्रह्मवर्चसी भूयासम् । रुगसि । रुचं मयि धेहि
4.6.m: May Dyutāna Māruta with the Maruts make you shine from the north with the anuṣṭubh metre! / Shining, make me shine! / May Bṛhaspati with all the gods make you shine from above with the paṅkti metre! / Shining, make me shine! / Made to shine, O god gharma, you are among the gods; / may I shine among mortals! / O sovereign gharma, shining among the gods, you are possessed of lifespan, brilliant, endowed with spiritual lustre; / made to shine among mortals, may I become possessed of lifespan, brilliant, endowed with spiritual lustre! / You are light; place light in me!

4.6.s: mayi ruk | daśa purastādrocase | daśa dakṣiṇā | daśa pratyaṅ | daśodaṅṅ | daśordhvo bhāsi sumanasyamānaḥ | sa naḥ samrāḍiṣamūrjaṃ dhehi | vājī vājine pavasva | rocito gharmo rucīya
4.6.d: मयि रुक् । दश पुरस्ताद्रोचसे । दश दक्षिणा । दश प्रत्यङ् । दशोदङ्ङ् । दशोर्ध्वो भासि सुमनस्यमानः । स नः सम्राडिषमूर्जं धेहि । वाजी वाजिने पवस्व । रोचितो घर्मो रुचीय
4.6.m: In me is light! / Ten [rays] you shine eastwards; ten southwards; ten westwards; / ten northwards; ten upwards you shine, being gracious. / As such, O sovereign, grant us food and sap! / O runner, flow for the runner! / The gharma has been made to shine; may I shine!

4.7.s: apaśyaṃ gopāmanipadyamānam | ā ca parā ca pathibhiścarantam | sa saddhrīcīssa viṣūcīrvasānaḥ | āvarīvarti bhuvaneṣvantaḥ | atra prāvīḥ | madhumādhvībhyāṃ madhumādhūcībhyām | anu vāṃ devavītaye | samagniragninā gata | saṃ devena savitrā | saṃ sūryeṇa rocate
4.7.d: अपश्यं गोपामनिपद्यमानम् । आ च परा च पथिभिश्चरन्तम् । स सद्ध्रीचीस्स विषूचीर्वसानः । आवरीवर्ति भुवनेष्वन्तः । अत्र प्रावीः । मधुमाध्वीभ्यां मधुमाधूचीभ्याम् । अनु वां देववीतये । समग्निरग्निना गत । सं देवेन सवित्रा । सं सूर्येण रोचते
4.7.m: I saw the herdsman who never tires, / moving to and fro along the paths; / clothing himself in those [regions] converging and diverging, / he rolls continually within the worlds. / You have protected here; / with sweet honey-streams, sweet and flowing with honey, / [we come] after you both for the feast of the gods. / Agni has united with Agni; / with the god Savitṛ; / he shines together with Sūrya.

4.7.s: svāhā samagnistapasā gata | saṃ devena savitrā | saṃ sūryeṇārociṣṭa | dhartā divo vibhāsi rajasaḥ | pṛthivyā dhartā | urorantarikṣasya dhartā | dhartā devo devānām | amartyastapojāḥ | hṛde tvā manase tvā | dive tvā sūryāya tvā
4.7.d: स्वाहा समग्निस्तपसा गत । सं देवेन सवित्रा । सं सूर्येणारोचिष्ट । धर्ता दिवो विभासि रजसः । पृथिव्या धर्ता । उरोरन्तरिक्षस्य धर्ता । धर्ता देवो देवानाम् । अमर्त्यस्तपोजाः । हृदे त्वा मनसे त्वा । दिवे त्वा सूर्याय त्वा
4.7.m: Svāhā! Agni has united with ascetic heat; / with the god Savitṛ; / he has shone together with Sūrya. / Supporter of the sky, you shine over the realm of space; / supporter of the earth; supporter of the broad intermediate space; / supporter, god of the gods; / immortal, born of ascetic heat! / For the heart, to you! For the mind, to you! / For the sky, to you! For Sūrya, to you!

4.7.s: ūrdhvamimamadhvaraṃ kṛdhi | divi deveṣu hotrā yaccha | viśvāsāṃ bhuvāṃ pate | viśvasya bhuvanaspate | viśvasya manasaspate | viśvasya vacasaspate | viśvasya tapasaspate | viśvasya brahmaṇaspate | devaśrūstvaṃ deva gharma devānpāhi | tapojāṃ vācamasme niyaccha devāyuvam
4.7.d: ऊर्ध्वमिममध्वरं कृधि । दिवि देवेषु होत्रा यच्छ । विश्वासां भुवां पते । विश्वस्य भुवनस्पते । विश्वस्य मनसस्पते । विश्वस्य वचसस्पते । विश्वस्य तपसस्पते । विश्वस्य ब्रह्मणस्पते । देवश्रूस्त्वं देव घर्म देवान्पाहि । तपोजां वाचमस्मे नियच्छ देवायुवम्
4.7.m: Make this sacrificial rite upright! / Offer the oblations in the sky among the gods, / O lord of all beings, / O lord of the whole world, / O lord of all mind, / O lord of all speech, / O lord of all ascetic heat, / O lord of all sacred lore! / Heard by the gods, O god gharma, protect the gods! / Direct to us god-seeking speech born of ascetic heat!

4.7.s: garbho devānām | pitā matīnām | patiḥ prajānām | matiḥ kavīnām | saṃ devo devena savitrā'yatiṣṭa | saṃ sūryeṇārukta | āyurdāstvamasmabhyaṃ gharma varcodā asi | pitā no'si pitā no bodha | āyurdhāstanūdhāḥ payodhāḥ | varcodā varivodā draviṇodāḥ
4.7.d: गर्भो देवानाम् । पिता मतीनाम् । पतिः प्रजानाम् । मतिः कवीनाम् । सं देवो देवेन सवित्राऽयतिष्ट । सं सूर्येणारुक्त । आयुर्दास्त्वमस्मभ्यं घर्म वर्चोदा असि । पिता नोऽसि पिता नो बोध । आयुर्धास्तनूधाः पयोधाः । वर्चोदा वरिवोदा द्रविणोदाः
4.7.m: Embryo of the gods, / father of thoughts, / lord of offspring, / wisdom of poets! / The god has aligned himself with the god Savitṛ; / he has shone together with Sūrya. / Lifespan-giver to us are you, O gharma; you are the lustre-giver. / You are our father; take notice of us as a father! / Bestower of lifespan, bestower of bodily vigour, bestower of milk, / bestower of lustre, bestower of wide room, bestower of wealth!

4.7.s: antarikṣapra urorvarīyān | aśīmahi tvā mā mā hiṃsīḥ | tvamagne gṛhapatirviśāmasi | viśvāsāṃ mānuṣīṇām | śataṃ pūrbhiryaviṣṭha pāhyaṃhasaḥ | sameddhāraṃ śataṃ himāḥ | tandrāviṇaṃ hārdivānam | ihaiva rātayassantu | tvaṣṭīmatī te sapeya | suretā reto dadhānā | vīraṃ videya tava saṃdṛśi | mā'haṃ rāyaspoṣeṇa viyoṣam
4.7.d: अन्तरिक्षप्र उरोर्वरीयान् । अशीमहि त्वा मा मा हिंसीः । त्वमग्ने गृहपतिर्विशामसि । विश्वासां मानुषीणाम् । शतं पूर्भिर्यविष्ठ पाह्यंहसः । समेद्धारं शतं हिमाः । तन्द्राविणं हार्दिवानम् । इहैव रातयस्सन्तु । त्वष्टीमती ते सपेय । सुरेता रेतो दधाना । वीरं विदेय तव संदृशि । माऽहं रायस्पोषेण वियोषम्
4.7.m: Filling the intermediate space, wider than the wide! / May we attain you; do not harm me! / You, O Agni, are the lord of the house of the clans, / of all human clans; / with a hundred fortresses, O youngest one, protect from distress / the kindler [of your fire] for a hundred winters! / Calming restlessness, delighting the heart; / right here let the gifts remain! / Possessing craftsmanship, may I serve you, / rich in seed, establishing the seed; / may I find a heroic son in your sight; / may I not be separated from the increase of wealth!
